In addition to earnings, MPs and their family members should declare real estate owned or rented (apartments, country houses, garages, and other objects). In Their total area An average Russian city could live on this amount for a whole year. For example, about the same is the average annual budget of Penza or Belgorod cities. MPs and their family members should declare real estate owned or rented ( in 2020 it was 43 km2. This is also comparable to the area of a small town near Moscow, for example, Sergiev Posad or
2022-s-0385.impact: This publication came out a few months before the Russian parliamentary elections in September 2021 and became part of Novaya Gazeta's coverage of the State Duma. We have collected the comprehensive dataset on the assets of Russian deputies, which allowed us to separately consider different types of real estate and land plots. It was the first publication that not only showed the enormous wealth of Russian MPs but offered a compelling data-driven story and a powerful visualization.
2022-s-0385.tools: Animation, Scraping, D3.js, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2022-s-0385.authors: Katya Bonch-Osmolovskaya, Antonina Asanova, Artem Shchennikov, Arnold Khachaturov
2022-s-0385.summaryJa: 毎年ロシア議員は収入申告を公表する.収入に加えて,議員と彼らの家族メンバーは不動産を所有または賃貸 (アパート,カントリーハウス,ガレージ,および他の物件) を申告しなければならない. 議員とその家族メンバーは不動産を所有しているまたは賃貸していることを宣言すべきです (2020年には43km2でした). これはモスクワ近くの小さな町の面積にも比較できます,例えば,Sergiev Posadまたは
2022-s-0385.impactJa: この出版物は2021年9月にロシア議会選挙が始まる数ヶ月前に公開され,ノヴァイア・ガゼタの国会総会報道の一部となった. ロシアの議員たちの膨大な富を示しだけでなく説得力のあるデータに基づくストーリーと強力な視覚化も提供した最初の出版物でした

2022-s-0386.summary: The project addresses racial inequality in Brazilian higher education. In the last ten years, public policies have been implemented with the aim of including more black and indigenous students in federal universities in Brazil. The result was positive and the number of black and low-income young people in universities increased a lot. On the other hand, the number of black professors in Brazilian higher education is still very low. We used microdata from the Higher Education Census to analyze the percentage of blacks in Higher Education and discuss the reasons for low representation and its consequences.
2022-s-0386.impact: The report was published on November 20 – a date that marks the celebration of black culture in Brazil. The repercussion on social networks was intense, generating debate in profiles of great national relevance. The project exposes the racial inequality existing in Brazilian universities and provides tools for the subject to be discussed in depth. The article compares the proportion of black professors at the university with the proportion of black people in the state where the university is based. We consider "adequate" the university in which the proportion of black inhabitants is equal to or greater than that of the State. We chose this methodology because Brazil is a very large and diverse country. While in some states the proportion of blacks is less than 20%, in others they are more than 75% of the population. Therefore, we prefer to analyze each reality separately. The main impact of the report is to show that elite universities, classified as the best in the country by international rankings, have very few black professors. None of them have the proper amount of blacks. At the University of São Paulo (USP), the most important in the country, only 4% of professors are black. We also show that public policies created to include more black teachers are flawed and insufficient. Another important impact is to show the consequences of low racial representation in Higher Education. Without diversity, there is no quality debate and universities are an important space for public debate. In addition, experts say that the lack of representation in classrooms ends up discouraging black students from entering higher education.
2022-s-0386.authors: Mariana Hallal, Bruno Ponceano, Maria Claudia Correa, Carlos Marin, Júlia Marques
2022-s-0386.summaryJa: このプロジェクトはブラジル高等教育における人種不平等を解決する.過去10年間で,ブラジル連邦大学により多くの黒人と土著系学生を含める目的で公共政策が実施されました. 結果は肯定的で,大学における黒人と低所得の若者の数はかなり増加しました.一方,ブラジル高等教育における黒人の教授の数は依然として非常に低い. 私たちは高等教育における黒人の割合を分析し代表性の低い理由とその結果について議論するために高等教育人口普查からマイクロデータを利用しました
2022-s-0386.impactJa: 報告書は11月20日に公開されました. この日はブラジルにおける黒人文化の祝いを象徴する日です. ソーシャルネットワークへの影響は激しく,大きな全国的な関連性のあるプロフィールでの議論を誘発しました. このプロジェクトはブラジル大学における人種的不平等を暴露し,このテーマを深く議論するためのツールを提供します. この論文では,大学にある黒人の教授の割合と,大学所在する州にある黒人の割合を比較しています. 私たちは黒人の住民の割合が州と同じか,州よりも大きい大学を"適切"と考えています. 私たちはこの方法を選んだのは,ブラジルが非常に広大で多様で,ある州では黒人の割合が20%未満で,他の州では人口の75%以上です. 報告書の主要影響は,国際ランキングで国のトップにランクされているエリート大学が黒人教授が少ないことを示しています. そのうちのどれにも適切な数の黒人教授がいないのです. サンパウロ大学 (USP) では,この国の最も重要な大学で,黒人教授の4%しかいません. また,黒人教師を多く含むために作られた公共政策は欠陥があり,十分ではないことを示しています. 重要影響は高等教育における人種代表性の低さの影響を示すことです多様性なしでは質の議論はなく大学は公共の議論の重要な空間ですさらに,専門家によると,教室での代表性の欠如は黒人の学生を高等教育に入学することを妨げています

2022-s-0387.summary: At the core of this project is a tool that analyzes and visualizes all speeches and oral contributions made in the Russian State Duma since its creation in 1994. The tool shows how often and in which years single terms (like ‘sanction’) or term combinations (like ‘alexei navalny’ or ‘foreing agent’) were used by deputies. This allows to understand the important trends in Russian politics and to trace the transformation of the Russian parliament. In the Russian and German versions of the project, the tool is accompanied by an analysis of the evolution of the Russian State Duma.
2022-s-0387.impact: The Russian State Duma plays a minor role in international reporting. The aim of the project was, on the one hand, to develop a tool to make the issues discussed in the State Duma tangible and, on the other hand, to give international readers an insight into the Russian parliament and to analyse how it has changed from its genesis in 1994 and how it ticks today and is positioned within the Putin system. With this project, we have reached a broad readership in Russian and German-speaking countries, first and foremost Russia and Germany, and call the project a success with over 110,000 users. The project itself became the subject of news coverage in Russia, for example it was reported on by online media Meduza.io and independent TV channel “TV Rain”. The project serves as a tool for many international journalists, researchers and politicians, from whom we have received very positive feedback.
2022-s-0387.authors: Leonid A. Klimov, Daniel Marcus, Katya Bonch-Osmolovskaya, Antonina Asanova, Artem Shchennikov, Arnold Khachaturov, Anton Devyatov, Dmitry Kartsev, Tamina Kutscher
2022-s-0387.summaryJa: このプロジェクトの核心は,ロシア国事院で1994年に創設された以来,すべてのスピーチや口頭貢献を分析し,視覚化するツールです. このツールでは,議会が単語の用語 (例えば <unk>制裁<unk>) または用語組み合わせ (例えば <unk>アレキシー・ナਵਲニ<unk>または <unk>foreing agent<unk>) をどのように使用したか,どの数年でどのように使用したか示しています. プロジェクトのロシア語とドイツ語版では,ツールにはロシア国事府の進化の分析が付随しています.
2022-s-0387.impactJa: ロシア国事院は国際報道において小規模な役割を果たしています.このプロジェクトの目的は,一方面,国事院で議論された問題を具体的なものにするためのツールを開発することであり,また,他の方面から,国際読者にロシア議会の洞察を与え,それが1994年の起源からどのように変化し,どのように今日も動いているかを分析することでした. このプロジェクトにより,ロシアとドイツ語圏の多くの読者を獲得し,まずロシアとドイツで 110,000人以上のユーザーでプロジェクトを成功と呼んでいます. このプロジェクト自体はロシアでニュース報道の対象になりました. 例えば,オンラインメディアMeduza.ioと独立テレビチャンネル <unk>TV Rain<unk>によって報告されました. このプロジェクトは国際ジャーナリストや研究者,政治家にとってツールとなり素晴らしいフィードバックを得ています

2022-s-0388.summary: Through expert interviews and research, this project analyzes the factors that lead to depression and anxiety in older Americans, as well as the steps retirees can take to combat these mental health conditions. This project is especially relevant in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, which has led to greater isolation among older people and deeply affected mental health and happiness.
2022-s-0388.impact: The biggest impact for the public has been bringing awareness and providing solutions to an issue that affects 20% of adults 55 or older. One month after publication, the project had 184 total page views, with an average time on page between 9 minutes and 14 minutes. Three domains had linked to the project as a resource for their users. The project had been shared 43 times on social media and garnered 59,142 impressions, and readers found a safe space to share their experiences in comments.
2022-s-0388.summaryJa: 専門家のインタビューと研究を通じて,このプロジェクトは高齢者のうつ病と不安の原因となる要因,および退職者がこれらの精神健康状態と戦うために 취할 수있는ステップを分析しています.このプロジェクトは特に COVID-19 流行の後に関連があります.これは高齢者の間でより大きな孤立をもたらし,精神健康と幸福を深く影響しています.
2022-s-0388.impactJa: 公開後1ヶ月で,プロジェクトには184件のページビューが集まった.平均ページ時間は9分から14分間の間に渡った. 3つのドメインは,ユーザー向けのリソースとしてプロジェクトにリンクしていた. プロジェクトがソーシャルメディアで43回共有され,59,142人の印象を得て読者はコメントで自分の体験を共有する安全な場所を見つけました

2022-s-0389.summary: This project uses original expert interviews and reporting as well as unique statistics and infographics to inform readers about out-of-pocket spending among Medicare beneficiaries and explain how the costs are expected to change and increase in the future. A Medicare beneficiary shares her story of how she has been negatively impacted by rising healthcare costs. While a Centers for Medicare & Medicaid representative offers insight into the federal government's future financial challenge of keeping the Medicare program solvent. The project examines significant policy proposals, legislative and advocacy efforts, and rule changes that may impact future out-of-pocket costs for beneficiaries.
2022-s-0389.impact: Through this project, we armed Medicare beneficiaries with current and accurate information about factors that affect their healthcare costs. We took complex data, centralized it and made it accessible to everyone. We connected readers with Medicare experts and resources that could help them find affordable healthcare options.
2022-s-0389.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,医療保険受益者の間での手当の支出について読者に知らせて,将来コストがどのように変化し,増加すると予想されているかを説明するために,オリジナルの専門家インタビューやレポート,およびユニークな統計とインフォグラフィックを使用しています. メディケア・プログラムが不給額に保たれるという連邦政府の将来の財政的課題について,メディケア・プログラム代表が洞察を提供している.このプロジェクトは,メディケア・プログラムに負担がかかる将来の費用に影響を与える重要な政策提案,立法および擁護活動,および規則変更を調査しています.
2022-s-0389.impactJa: このプロジェクトを通じて,私たちは医療費を支える要因について現在の正確な情報を提供しました. 複雑なデータを集めて,集中化し,すべての人にアクセスできるようにしました. 読者を医療費の専門家と資源と結びつけ,医療費の選択肢を見つけるのに役立つリソースを提供しました.

2022-s-0390.summary: Using a dictionary that researchers use to rate words for positivity or negativity, USA TODAY examined a trove of 80,146 Parler posts captured by analysts at the Social Media Analysis Toolkit before Parler went offline. The posts run from 9 a.m., when Trump supporters ramped up their Save America rally in Washington, to 2:30 p.m., when the Capitol was under full siege. To assess what was driving changes in sentiment, the news organization also examined words and phrases that gained the most as a share of Parler traffic over time. Data visualizations made the connections clear.
2022-s-0390.impact: Not only did this project resonate strongly with readers, gaining wide audience interest, it also caught the eyes of lawmakers. It was cited and shown during President Trump's impeachment hearings. The analysis adds weight to reports quoting attorneys for riot suspects saying Trump's speech inspired the attack on the Capitol. Such interpretations of Trump's words were at the center of an impeachment trial of the president in the Senate that begins next week.
2022-s-0390.authors: Aleszu Bajak, Jessica Guynn, Mitchell Thorson
2022-s-0390.summaryJa: 分析者は,パーラーがオフラインになる前に,ソーシャルメディア分析ツールキットで撮影した 80,146件のパーラー投稿を調査した.トランプ支持者がワシントンでSave America集会を拡大した午前9時から午後2時半まで,キャピトルは全面的に包囲されていた. 報道機関では,感情の変化を促している要因を評価するために,時間とともにパーラートラフィックで最も多く増加した言葉やフレーズも調べました.データビジュアライゼーションにより,つながりが明確になりました.
2022-s-0390.impactJa: このプロジェクトは読者達と強く共鳴し,幅広い聴衆の関心も獲得しただけでなく,立法者の目にもひっくり返した.トランプ大統領の弾<unk>審議中に引用され,示された.この分析は,暴動容疑者の弁護士がトランプ氏の演説がキャピトルの攻撃を刺激したと述べた報告書を引用した重みを加えた.トランプ氏の発言は来週から始まる上院で大統領への弾<unk>裁判の中心となった.

2022-s-0391.summary: Roughly 3,4 million people in Ceará are at high or very high risk of coronavirus in regions without official information about oxygen availability in hospitals. Towns were warned about the possibility of shortages, and the lack of transparency impedes the understanding of the State’s real input infrastructure.
2022-s-0391.impact: The impact of the project was to expose the lack of transparency of public data from the state of Ceará to the population and reveal that a large portion of the population of the poorest cities in the state have the hospital network without oxygen.
2022-s-0391.summaryJa: 病院での酸素利用率に関する公式情報のない地域では,セアラでは約3400万人が高または非常に高リスクでコロナウイルス感染を患っています. 都市は短縮の可能性に警告され,透明性の欠如は,国家の実態のインフラへの理解を妨げています.
2022-s-0391.impactJa: プロジェクトの影響はセルビア州から公開された公共データの透明性の欠如を人民に暴露し州内の最貧都市の人口の大部分が酸素のない病院ネットワークを持っていることを明らかにしました

2022-s-0392.summary: The PH is a public health current affairs TV Series that raises awareness about global issues in the sector. The PH is uniquely positioned to feature interviews with global stakeholders, who can simplify high level scientific data about public health issues, from the COVID-19 pandemic to road safety. Public Health Media Limited produces the content and then distributes it to Television Jamaica Limited for broadcast through an agreement.
2022-s-0392.impact: Reaching more than 300, 000 Jamaicans through TV broadcast on various topics about public health, including COVID-19, racism, mental health, pregnant women and COVID-19, COVID-19 vaccines, water and air pollution, sustainable buildings, and toxic substances. Through these episodes Jamaicans and anyone who watched the post-broadcast episodes on YouTube were provided with evidenced-based information about the various issues, tips and solutions on how individuals and institutions can play a significant role in solving the probelms identified, and expert opinions about the matters. The episodes included experts from the United Nations Environment Programme and other notable organizations.
2022-s-0392.authors: Donnelle Christian (series creator/content producer/host/writer), Kiesha-Ann Reid (Supervising Producer), Ian Guthrie (Director of Photography/Film), Danille Gordon (Video Editor/Graphics), Tamica Parchment (writer)
2022-s-0392.summaryJa: PHは,この分野におけるグローバルな問題に関する意識を高める公共衛生の現況テレビシリーズである. PHは,COVID-19の流行から道路安全まで,公衆衛生に関する高レベルの科学データを簡素化できるグローバルな関係者とのインタビューを特化した.
2022-s-0392.impactJa: 公共衛生に関する様々な話題についてテレビ放送を通じて300,000人以上のジャマイカ人に届けました. コビッド-19,人種差別,精神衛生,妊婦とCOVID-19,COVID-19ワクチン,水と空気の汚染,持続可能な建物,そして毒物質などです. このエピソードを通じて,ジャマイカの人々やYouTubeで放送後のエピソードを見たすべての人たちは,特定された問題解決に個人や機関が重要な役割を果たす方法に関する様々な問題,ヒント,解決策に関する証拠に基づいた情報,および問題に関する専門家の意見を提供されました.エピソードには国連環境計画および他の著名な組織からの専門家が含まれました.

2022-s-0393.summary: The adoption of children and adolescents by state civil servants collides with anti-constitutional regulations that establish differences between the children of adoptive parents and the biological ones. Most licenses granted to adopters are for just 30 days. The survey carried out in the 27 statutes of state civil servants revealed that, with the exception of the states mentioned, the license granted is inversely proportional to the age of the adoptee, that is, the older he is, the shorter the term granted.
2022-s-0393.impact: The project reveals the failure of the Public Ministry to call the state and municipal Executive to update their statutes, as well as representing a total lack of information from the powers. When the state does not update its law, according to the new decision of the Federal Supreme Court, it ends up generating the burden for those who no longer have the right they should have. And this is the reality in Brazil, 67% of Brazilian states deny their adopting public servants and adopted children and adolescents, under the prism of the best interest of the child and the right to coexistence, the establishment of affective bonds and the reception in the new family nucleus.
2022-s-0393.summaryJa: 養子や青少年を公務員に養子と養子育ての権利が認められるのは憲法に反する規則と衝突しているため養子や生殖者との間の差異は認められている.養子育ての許可はほとんど30日しかありません. 州公務員27人の法規で実施された調査は,上記州を除いて,授予された免許は,受領者の年齢に逆比例していることが明らかになった.
2022-s-0393.impactJa: 公共省が州と市役員に法令更新を呼びかけないことや権限からの情報の欠如を明らかにする. 連邦最高裁の新しい決定に従って州が法律を更新しないとき,もはや権利を持っていない人々への負担を発生させる. ブラジルでは 67%の州が養子公務員と養子や青少年を養子と親子と親子と親子と親子と親子との間の親子との関係を結びつけることや家庭内での親子との関係を認めないことを否定しています

2022-s-0394.summary: We asked people what key issue they wanted the candidates to be talking about as they competed for their votes in Edmonton's 2021 municipal election. Then we turned that input into an interactive survey that would allow voters to quickly find out which candidates aligned best with their values. The survey results played a big role in our coverage leading up to election night on Oct. 18, 2021, showing not only who won but also what they stood for.
2022-s-0394.impact: From Sept. 23 to Oct. 18, 2021, we received more than 21,000 responses to our survey from people seeking to find out who they agreed with most among those running for mayor and council in their ward. Anecdotally, a number of people shared on social media that we had the best tool to help them decide how to vote, and they shared it enthusiastically. "The survey was very well done," said one user. "The context was short, but well referenced and made for solid opportunities to explore topics in greater detail. And then at the end, you can see how each candidate responded? ::chef's kiss::" Another said: "Shout out to @taprootyeg, the real MVP of #yegcc #yegVote. If you're gonna give a local org some dollars, the Taproot folks are an incredible team." The project seemed to be the deciding factor for about a dozen people to upgrade to paid memberships. Our mailing list for our daily newsletter grew from 340 in January 2021 to 2,400 by the end of October, and while this project would not be the only factor, it is part of what has grown awareness of Taproot as a reliable and valuable source of information on civic affairs.
2022-s-0394.tools: Scraping, JQuery, Json, Microsoft Excel, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2022-s-0394.authors: Mack Male, Karen Unland, Madeleine Stout, Emily Rendell-Watson, Meenakshi Chaudhary, Jackson Spring, Chris Chang-Yen Phillips, Troy Pavlek, Elise Stolte, Rob Houle
2022-s-0394.summaryJa: エドモントン市議会選挙2021年の選挙で投票に参戦する際に候補者が何を語るべきか尋ねました.その後,その入力をインタラクティブな調査に変換し,投票者は,どちらの候補者が彼らの価値観に最も適合しているかすぐに知ることができるようにしました.調査結果は2021年10月18日の選挙夜までの私たちの報道に大きな役割を果たし,誰が勝っただけでなく,何を支持したかを示しました.
2022-s-0394.impactJa: 2021年9月23日から10月18日まで,市長や市議会候補者のうち誰と最も賛成かを調べようとした人々の調査に対する回答は21,000件以上でした. 逸話として,何人かの人々がソーシャルメディアで,投票方法を決定するのに役立つ最良のツールがあると共有し,熱心に共有しました. "調査は非常にうまく行われました"とあるユーザーが語った. "文脈は短いが,参考に適したもので,より詳細なトピックを探索する機会を備えた.そして最後に,各候補者がどのように反応したかを見ることができます. 2021年1月340日からのニュースレターメールリストは10月末までに2400人に増えました. このプロジェクトは唯一の要因ではないが,市民問題に関する信頼できる貴重な情報源としてタプロットに意識が広がる部分です.

2022-s-0395.summary: This project explores the risk of running out of money in retirement. It identifies how often Americans run out of money in later life and which demographics are at high risk by analyzing relevant timely studies and incorporating original expert interviews. It also offers tips on how to avoid running out of money by planning early, creating a post-retirement budget and utilizing various financial products, such as retirement accounts and annuities.
2022-s-0395.impact: The project educates readers about the risk of running out of money in retirement and how to guard against outliving their savings. We answer the questions: How common is it for Americans to run out of money in retirement? Who is at risk? How do I prevent it from happening? The project resulted in 1,181 pageviews, with an average time on page of nearly 9 minutes. More than 20 websites included a link to the project as a resource for their visitors. Within two weeks of publication, the project had 504,370 impressions on social media.
2022-s-0395.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,退職後,お金が尽きるリスクを探索します. 適切な時間的な研究を分析し,オリジナルの専門家インタビューを組み込み,アメリカ人が後世でお金が尽きる頻度やどの人口統計が高いリスクにあるかを特定します. また,早期に計画し,退職後の予算を作成し,退職口座や年金などのさまざまな金融製品を活用することによって,お金が尽きることを避けるためのアドバイスも提供します.
2022-s-0395.impactJa: このプロジェクトでは,退職後,お金がなくなってしまうリスクや貯蓄を過失させないように注意することについて読者に教えています.私たちは,アメリカ人が退職後,お金がなくなることがどれほど一般的なのかという質問に答えます.誰が危険にさらされているのか?それをどのように防ぐことができるのか? このプロジェクトの結果,ページビューは1,181件,平均ページ閲覧時間はほぼ9分でした. 20以上のウェブサイトには,プロジェクトへのリンクが訪問者のためのリソースとして含まれていました. 公開後2週間以内にソーシャルメディアで 504,370人の印象が集まった.

2022-s-0396.summary: Salud, Dinero y Corrupción is a data journalism project led by PODER that showed that the Mexican Social Security Institute was buying drugs at overpriced prices while there was a shortage of vital supplies in hospitals. It is a project that goes through the whole process of data journalism: webscraping, cleaning and analysis, data science, collaborative journalistic research among six media outlets and massive publication of data for reuse by the audience.
2022-s-0396.impact: Salud, Dinero y Corrupción had and is having a very important impact on multiple actors involved in the purchase of medicines in Mexico. Dividing it into blocks: - Mexican Institute of Social Security: on the same day of publication it issued a statement acknowledging the project's information and announcing internal investigations. The statement can be found on the project's web page. - Government and opposition: Since the project crosses several administrations the information was taken up by several political parties appearing both in the President's morning conference and in the Senate's oversight session questions. - UNOPS: Following the publication, the UN procurement agency has twice updated its open procurement transparency portal to facilitate access to drug data. - Patients and civil society: The project was key in demonstrating that the consolidated purchasing system did not work and changed both the discourse and advocacy strategies of organizations.
2022-s-0396.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Node.js
2022-s-0396.authors: Eduard Martín-Borregón, Claudia Ocaranza, Martín Szyszlican, Queletzú Aspra, Fernando Matzdorf, Marisol Carrillo, Ricardo Balderas, Andrés Castañeda, Ricardo Sangines, Dulce Rodríguez, Elizabeth Rosales, Alejandra Padilla, Ernesto Aroche, Darwin Franco
2022-s-0396.summaryJa: 医療,お金,汚職はPODERが率いるデータジャーナリズムプロジェクトで,メキシコ社会保障研究所が病院で重要な物資の不足が起きた間に,過高価格で薬物を購入していたことを示した. ウェブスクラッピング,クリーンリングと分析,データサイエンス,6つのメディア・アウトレーター間で協力的なジャーナリズムの研究,そして大規模なデータ公開は,データジャーナリズム全体のプロセスを通じています.
2022-s-0396.impactJa: メキシコの医療費の購入に関与する複数の関係者に対して,健康,お金,腐敗が非常に重要な影響を与えた. 分断をブロックにしました: - メキシコ社会保険研究所:出版の同じ日に,プロジェクトの情報を承認し,内部調査を発表した声明を発表した. - 政府と反対派: このプロジェクトは複数の行政機関を横断しているため, 大統領の朝の会議や上院の監視セッションの質問で複数の政党が情報を取り上げました. - UNOPS: 発表後,国連調達機関がドラッグデータへのアクセスを容易にするために 2回オープン調達透明性ポータルを更新しました. - 患者と市民社会: プロジェクトが統合購買システムが機能しなかったことを示し組織の議論と擁護戦略の両方を変化させた.

2022-s-0397.summary: China is a global economic powerhouse, but its system remains opaque. Policymakers and financial experts disagree on basic facts about what is happening inside the country. To create a shared language for understanding the Chinese economy, the China Pathfinder project scores China and ten open market economies across six key areas and presents an objective picture of China relative to the world.
2022-s-0397.impact: Designed to impact public discussion and facilitate better understanding of the implications of China’s different systemic path, China Pathfinder balances accessibility for non-technical readers with a commitment to robust, transparent, data-grounded methods. The primary audiences for the project are the United States private sector and policy makers, as well as government officials in other open-market economies. China Pathfinder was successfully launched in October 2021 with a special address given by OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann. The launch received widespread media attention and generated articles from Politico, the South China Morning Post, and more than 100 other news organizations discussing the project’s research and findings. The US policy community has also expressed strong interest in the project; the China Pathfinder team briefed the Department of State, Department of Treasury, and individual members of both the House and the Senate.
2022-s-0397.authors: Daniel H. Rosen, Thilo Hanemann, Nargiza Salidjanova, Rachel Lietzow, Josh Lipsky, Niels Graham, Nick Harbaugh, Lauren Malkani
2022-s-0397.summaryJa: 中国は世界経済大国だが,そのシステムは不透明である.政策立案者や金融専門家たちは,国内で起こっていることについての基本事実について意見が異なっています.中国の経済を理解するための共通の言語を作成するために,中国・パースファインダープロジェクトは中国と10のオープンマーケット・エコノミーを6つの重要な領域で評価し,世界の相対性における中国の客観的なイメージを提示します.
2022-s-0397.impactJa: 中国・パースファインダーは,中国の異なるシステム的な経路の影響をよりよく理解し,公衆の議論に影響を与えることを目的としたもので,技術以外の読者へのアクセシビリティを堅牢で透明でデータベースの方法へのコミットメントとバランスしています.このプロジェクトの主要な観客は米国民間部門や政策立案者,および他のオープン市場経済における政府関係者です. 中国パースファインダーは2021年10月にOECD事務総長マティアス・コルマンによって特別演説で成功に開始されました.この開始はメディアの注目を受け,Politico,サウス中国モーニングポスト,および他の100以上の報道機関からプロジェクトの研究と発見について記事を集めました. 米国政策界もこのプロジェクトに強い関心を示しており,中国パースファインダーチームは国務省,財務省,そして上院の各メンバーに報告した.

2022-s-0398.summary: Only 10 units of the federation grant the same period of maternity leave to same-sex couples in the state public service. The survey by O POVO shows how the States remain behind. However, for servants, for one of them to receive paternity leave, judicialization is necessary. In other words, there is already discrimination against couples formed by two men or two women, making it simpler to grant this type of license to male couples.
2022-s-0398.impact: The impact of this report is in the act of revealing discrimination and non-guarantees of rights to homosexual public servants who adopt children in Brazil. The states deny the time of leave allowed by the federal justice and make this type of relationship invisible within the public administration.
2022-s-0398.tools: D3.js, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio
2022-s-0398.summaryJa: 連邦の10個だけが,公務員公務員に同じ期間母制休暇を与えています. OPOVOの調査は,米国がどのように遅れていくかを示しています.しかし,そのうちの1人が父親制休暇を受けるために,公務員には司法化が必要である.
2022-s-0398.impactJa: この報告書の影響は,ブラジルで子供を養子にする同性愛者公務員に対する差別や権利の保証を明らかにする行為です.州は連邦司法によって許可された休日を否定し,この種の関係を公共行政内で目に見えないようにします.

2022-s-0399.summary: The USA Today Network talked with scientists and experts and examined years of tornado data to understand and show how millions of Americans living in the South are at an even greater risk for tornadoes than those in the Plains.
2022-s-0399.impact: Much of the South, which is more vulnerable than “Tornado Alley,” is increasingly in harm’s way. Our colleague Dinah Pulver and others noticed this and worked hard to spread awareness so that more people would be aware that they were in harm's way and get prepared. Clear and comprehensive data visualizations and explanatory graphics communicated the expansion of tornadic activity into new, densely populated areas and illustrated the ways it was fueled by climate change. The project also brought in impressive readership and engagement numbers.
2022-s-0399.tools: Animation, D3.js, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, R
2022-s-0399.authors: Dinah Pulver, Mitchell Thorson, Ramon Padilla, Stephen J. Beard, Doyle Rice, Shawn Sullivan, Melissa Brown, Paul Woolverton, Adam Friedman, Caitlin Herrington, Mary Landers, Gabriela Szymanowska, Mara Corbett, Kyle Omphroy, Ken Ruinard, Mike Burns
2022-s-0399.summaryJa: USA Todayネットワークは科学者や専門家と話をし長年の竜巻データを調査し南部の何百万人ものアメリカ人が竜巻のリスクが平原地域よりも高いことを示しました
2022-s-0399.impactJa: <unk>竜巻の発生が拡大している南部の大部分は,<unk>竜巻の発生より脆弱である<unk>.我々の同僚ディナ・パルバーや他の者は,この状況を認識し,より多くの人々が危険にさらされていることを認識し,準備できるようにするために懸命に努力しました.明確な,包括的なデータビジュアライゼーションと説明グラフィックにより,竜巻の発生が新人口密集した地域へ拡大し,気候変動によってどのように推進されているかを示しました. プロジェクトも読者数と関心率も印象的でした

2022-s-0400.summary: This project explores how the COVID-19 pandemic affected women, particularly women of color, and their ability to rejoin the workforce after having been unemployed for an extended period of time. December 2020 job reports showed that women lost 156,000 jobs, as compared with men who gained 16,000 jobs in a month that marked the highest job losses since May 2020. This project examines these discrepancies and the long-term implications of gender inequality and socioeconomic status on Americans during a time of crisis. It also offers resources and advice for women directly from women with specialized expertise.
2022-s-0400.impact: Fifty-five websites referenced and linked to the project as a resources for thier readers. It reached 13,803 users on social media, and readers viewed the project 500 times, spending on average more than 12 minutes on the page.
2022-s-0400.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,COVID-19の流行が女性,特に色人種の女性に影響を与えた方法と,長期間にわたって失業した後,労働力復帰する能力について調査しています.2020年12月の雇用報告によると,女性たちは156,000の雇用を失い,男性と比べて1月間に16,000の雇用を獲得した男性と比べて,2020年5月以降で最も高い雇用喪失を示しています. このプロジェクトは,危機期における男女格差と社会経済状況がアメリカ人にとって長期に及ぶ影響について検討し,また,専門知識を持つ女性から直接女性へのリソースと助言を提供しています.
2022-s-0400.impactJa: 55のウェブサイトが本プロジェクトを読者向けに資源として参照しリンクしました.このサイトはソーシャルメディアで13,803人のユーザーに達し,読者は本プロジェクトを500回閲覧し,平均して12分以上ページに費やしました.

2022-s-0401.summary: This story reveals for the first time that millions of Texas' students have been subject to surveillance of their digital communications by their schools, often without their knowledge or consent. These technologies, which can monitor students' email, social media, Hangout chats and even Google Docs, have been used by more than 200 districts in Texas. Legal and privacy experts have long raised concerns about these technologies, but thus far their use has not been litigated by the courts. The story also documents how Texas’ top lawmakers (including the governor and a U.S. senator) pushed for the adoption of these services.
2022-s-0401.impact: In response to my findings, a state lawmaker pledged to introduce legislation on the issue in the next session saying "Parents do not know, unfortunately, that their kids are part of a mass surveillance effort, and we need to address that, quite simply," he told me. I was also asked to appear on The Daily Dive, a national news podcast from iHeartRadio, to discuss my findings.
2022-s-0401.tools: QGIS, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2022-s-0401.summaryJa: この話では,初めて,テキサス州の何百万人もの生徒が,しばしば彼らの知識や同意なしに,彼らのデジタル通信を監視していることが明らかになりました.この技術が,学生のメール,ソーシャルメディア,Hangoutチャット,そしてGoogle文書さえ監視できる. 法律とプライバシーに関する専門家たちは長い間,これらの技術について懸念を表明してきたが,これまでのところ,その使用は裁判所によって訴訟されていなかった.この物語はまた,テキサス州最高立法者 (州知事と米国上院議員を含む) がこれらのサービスの採用を促した方法も記録している.
2022-s-0401.impactJa: 私の調査結果に応じて,州議員は次のセッションでこの問題に関する立法を導入すると約束し",残念ながら,両親は子供たちが大規模な監視活動の一部であることを知らないし,それについて単純に対処する必要がある"と私に語った.私はまた iHeartRadioの全国ニュースポッドキャスト"The Daily Dive"に出席して私の調査結果を議論するよう依頼された.

2022-s-0402.summary: Jair Bolsonaro completes, on September 26, 2021, his 1.000 days of a management full of controversies, tensions, confusion. More shacks than bridges, to use terms between lowliness and diplomacy. Complex days. Of almost 590.000 deaths resulting from a poorly managed, denied and poorly assisted pandemic. Days of hatred, of coercion to the press, of attacks and threats to democracy, of cursing and disrespect, aggressions by the Executive towards the Judiciary. It is a journalistic dossier that presents analyzes of information generated by the government.
2022-s-0402.impact: It is a journalistic dossier that presents this of information generated by the government. A science denier, the president despised the strength of the coronavirus pandemic. He is against the use of masks, advocates early treatment and proven ineffective medications, was critical of the vaccine and polemicized with state managers over the isolation measures. He is appointed as the main responsible for the account of almost 600 thousand deaths in the country since 2020. The Covid CPI, in the Senate, has already anticipated that he will be denounced even for crimes against humanity.
2022-s-0402.summaryJa: 博尔ソナロは2021年9月26日に,彼の1000日間を,論争,緊張,混乱に満ちた管理で完了しました. 低素性と外交の間の用語を使用するために橋よりも多くの棚屋. 複雑な日. 管理が悪かった,否定され,支援が悪かったパンデミックの結果,ほぼ590,000人の死亡. 憎悪の日,報道への強制,民主主義への攻撃と脅威, 呪いと不尊重,司法に対する行政当局による侵略. 政府の情報分析を提示するジャーナリズムの資料です
2022-s-0402.impactJa: 政府の情報提供を報道した新聞の記録です. 科学否定者として,大統領はコロナウイルス流行の強さを軽視した.彼は仮面の使用に反対し,早期治療と効果のない薬剤を擁護し,ワクチンを批判し,隔離措置について州管理者と論争した.彼は2020年以降,国内でほぼ600,000人の死亡の最大の責任者として任命されています. 議会では,彼は人道に対する犯罪でも起訴されるだろうと予想しています.

2022-s-0403.summary: Between 2015 and 2020, there was a 117% increase in fire outbreaks in the capital of Ceará. There are no centralized statistics in the State on the outbreaks and occurrences of fires in the area of ​​the Cocó State Park - whether as large as this week's or medium and insignificant. The dispersion of data can interfere with the strategy to combat the occurrences.
2022-s-0403.impact: The impact of this work is to reveal the absence of environmental monitoring in areas of environmental protection in the fifth most populous capital of Brazil, at the same time revealing inconsistent data systems, which compromises the direction of public policies aimed at environmental protection.
2022-s-0403.authors: Cláudio Ribeiro, Alexandre Cajazeira, Miguel Pontes, Roberto Araújo e Thays Lavor
2022-s-0403.summaryJa: 2015年から2020年の間に,セアラ首都で火災発生が117%増加した. ココ州立公園のエリアでの火災発生と発生に関する中央集権的な統計はありません. この週の大規模か中小か微不足道かです.
2022-s-0403.impactJa: この研究の影響は,ブラジル第5番目に人口多い首都の環境保護地域における環境監視の欠如を明らかにし,同時に不一致なデータシステムを明らかにし,環境保護を目的とした公共政策の方向性を損なうものである.

2022-s-0404.summary: Pesticides were used as weapons in 305 cases of attempted poisoning with pesticides in the last decade, according to data from the Sistema de Agravos de Notificação (Sinan). In 77% of the cases the violence occurred inside the house. The exclusive survey by Agência Pública and Repórter Brasil reveals a deviation in the use of agricultural products, which are being used to kill and threaten people. There were 32 homicides with the products during this period.
2022-s-0404.impact: The impact of this work is to show one more of the problems with the use of pesticides in Brazil and the threats to women's lives. The lack of enforcement and effective laws put people's lives at risk, especially the population further away from large urban centers.
2022-s-0404.authors: Pedro Grigori , Thays Lavor, Bruno Fonseca
2022-s-0404.summaryJa: 農薬は,過去10年間で農薬による毒害の305例で武器として使用された. 報告の加害者システム (Sinan) のデータによると,その77%のケースでは,暴力が家内で発生した. ブラジル公報局による独占調査では,農産物の使用の偏見が明らかになりました.
2022-s-0404.impactJa: この研究の影響は,ブラジルにおける農薬の使用と女性の命に対する脅威の問題を示すことである. 執行や効果的な法律の欠如は,特に都市の中心から遠く離れた人口を脅かす.

2022-s-0405.summary: Pactocheck is a project to track the government agreement reached by two political parties, PSOE and Unidas Podemos. On this page we track 100 commitments signed by the formations led by Pedro Sánchez and -at the time of the signing of the agreement- Pablo Iglesias, to assess to what extent the agreements reached in the pact to govern are being fulfilled or not. Newtral's team reviews weekly a selection of 100 of the promises contained in the agreement to know their status, based on a methodology explained on the website.
2022-s-0405.impact: Pactocheck is a information project that is constantly referenced and visited. It has more than 15.000 views and the average reading time on page is more than 5 minutes. It has reached more than 300.000 interactions on social networks as Twitter. The promotional video in Facebook has more than 800 views.In Instagram, this content has been shared in the Reels format with 3.000 views and 3.201 accounts reached and in Stories format with 1,622 accounts reached. The post has more than 6.000 views. https://twitter.com/Newtral/status/1415615139445936134 https://twitter.com/Newtral/status/1451458544147091469 https://fb.watch/avNei7RAyu/ https://fb.watch/avNfqmQcbO/ https://www.instagram.com/reel/CRWBqx7qirQ/?utm_medium=copy_link https://www.instagram.com/p/CRWAkdLKRhx/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link
2022-s-0405.authors: Alba Martín, Andrea Real, Cristina Alonso, Elena Turrión, Guillermo Infantes, Irene Larraz, José Denis Cruz, Laura García, María Pascual Gómez, Nahiara Alonso, Paula Boira, Thess Móstoles, Tomás Rudich, Yolanda García
2022-s-0405.summaryJa: このページでは,ペドロ・サンチェスと - 協定の署名時に - パブロ・イグلیسیアスが率いる組織が署名した100のコミットメントを追跡し,統治協定で達成された合意がどの程度達成されているか評価します. ニュートラルのチームはウェブサイトで説明された方法に基づいて,契約の100の約束の選択を週ごとにレビューしています.

2022-s-0406.summary: The Global Gig Workers is a deep dive into the lives of millions of workers around the world dealing with the common concerns brought about by the emergent platform economy. It is the result of a months-long investigation and data collection effort—one that surveyed nearly 5000 workers and interviewed dozens more. It includes a longform story on efforts to collectivize, unionize, and generally connect global gig workers, data-driven investigations into gender-based pay disparity and more issues shared by workers across the world, and day-in-the-life profiles of workers in Korea, India, Sri Lanka, Colombia, Ethiopia, Indonesia, and South Africa.
2022-s-0406.impact: This package has become a reference point for our continuing work on the platform economy. We have used our findings to pursue further reporting, highlighting unethical and unsustainable working practices in Asia, Africa, and Latin America. It has been cited in other media outlets (Wired, The Verge, The Guardian, Quartz, Techcabal, Tech in Asia, and more) and by academic researchers and labor activists. One of the Indian workers featured in the story, encouraged by the response to its publication, began legal proceedings against the platform company he worked for.

2022-s-0407.summary: More than 18.000 unaccompanied foreign minors have disappeared in Europe in just three years. The Ombudsman again pointed out in its 2020 annual report that there is no concordance between the data on unaccompanied foreign minors in Spain and those arriving from one year to the next. Experts in law and migration call for a central registry in the EU. In Newtral we have searched the data, we talked to experts and these minors, to present the numbers with an analysis and visualizations for the audience to grasp the scale of it.

2022-s-0410.summary: After the murder of George Floyd by Minneapolis police, Crosscut decided to find out how many cops in Washington state had been flagged by prosecutors as having credibility issues, yet who remained working as police officers. This involved requesting thousands of pages of documents – more than 100 records requests in all – to create a unique database of officers who had been flagged by prosecutors for issues such as lying, filing inaccurate reports, showing racial bias and using excessive force, but who didn’t lose their jobs as a result.
2022-s-0410.impact: By examining prosecutors’ files across 39 Washington counties, Crosscut identified 183 cops who had been flagged by prosecutors as having credibility issues, yet who continued to work in law enforcement. Prosecutors track these officers using lists commonly known as Brady lists. Additional reporting revealed some of these officers had initially been fired for their actions, but were later reinstated through arbitration. This fueled discussions in the state Legislature about reforming arbitration rules, a debate that continues today. Our reporting also exposed the limits of a new police accountability law, showing that – contrary to key legislators’ intent – the measure would not go after officers for past misconduct. This prompted the speaker of the state House to say that it may be necessary to refine and clarify this new law. Our reporting also pushed some county prosecutors to update their Brady lists to include additional officers. In other cases, county prosecutors refined their systems for tracking troubled cops. The same day our project came out, the state’s Black Lives Matter Alliance called on the state Attorney General to investigate officers who had been placed on prosecutors' Brady lists. A day after our series was published, a statewide watchdog group, the Washington Coalition For Open Government, gave us an award for advancing the cause of open government in Washington state.
2022-s-0410.summaryJa: ジョージ・フロイドがミネアポリス警察によって殺害された後クロスカット氏はワシントン州の警察官の数を検察が信用問題として標識したものの警官として勤務した人はどれくらいいるのか調べることにしました文書の何千ページを要求し記録の100件以上を要求し起訴した警察官が嘘,不正確な報告,人種差別や過剰な武力行使などで警官を標識したものの失職した警察官のデータベースを作成しました
2022-s-0410.impactJa: 検察は39のワシントン郡で検察官のファイルを調べて,検察官によって信頼性問題があると標識された183人の警察官を特定した.しかしながら,警察に引き続き勤めていた.検察官は,通常ブラディリストとして知られるリストを使用してこれらの警察官を追跡した.追加の報告によると,これらの警察官のいくつかは最初は彼らの行動のために解雇されたが,後に仲裁によって復帰された. この事件は,仲裁規則改革に関する州議会での議論を刺激し,今日も続いている議論です.我々の報告はまた,新しい警察責任法の限界を暴露し,重要な立法者への意図に反して,この措置は過去の不当行為のために警察官を追いかけるつもりはないことを示唆しました.これは州議会議長にこの新しい法律を精製し,明確化する必要があるかもしれないと言うことを促しました. 報道は,いくつかの地方検察官をブラディのリストを更新し,追加警官を入れることを促した.他のケースでは,地方検察官は,問題を抱えた警察を追跡するためのシステムを改良した.我々のプロジェクトが公開された同じ日に,州黒人生活問題同盟は,州検察官総長に,ブラディのリストに配置された警官を調査するよう求めた. 公開された翌日ワシントン州でオープン政府を推進する賞をワシントン州でオープン政府を推進する賞をワシントン州でオープン政府を監視する団体に贈りました

2022-s-0411.summary: This was a collaborative project that exposed extensive inadequacies in the UK’s response to modern slavery more than five years on from the introduction of landmark legislation. It was anchored on a number of data-driven pieces and built upon by searching news pieces and features from an eight-strong team of reporters located in newsrooms across the UK. We put together a comprehensive article pack to share with our local newsrooms across JPIMedia, containing exclusive FOI findings and open data analysis with data organised to allow titles to localise their coverage to their own police force or council areas.
2022-s-0411.impact: The UK’s landmark modern slavery legislation was purportedly designed to send “the strongest possible message to criminals that if you are involved in this disgusting trade in human beings you will be arrested, you will be prosecuted and you will be locked up”. Our reporting showed the opposite is true. The vast majority of cases investigated by police have seen no charges brought – our analysis found that UK police forces had failed to bring charges in more than 19,000 modern slavery offences since 2015, 19 out of 20 cases – while the CPS had lost four out of five of the small number of cases that make it to court, with suspects waking free and even those found guilty often escaping with nothing more than a fine. Our findings were clear – despite strong rhetoric from politicians, not only are slavery offences taking place on a vast scale in every corner of the UK, the perpetrators are going largely unpunished. Freedom of Information Act requests also exposed how the UK may be breaching its international obligations to ensure victims of modern slavery have access to compensation – the 2015 legislation having reiterated the importance of such compensation to victims’ recovery and introduced new measures such as Slavery and Trafficking Reparation Orders. The figures we obtained showed the vast majority of applicants to Government-sponsored programmes of redress are unsuccessful. Figures also suggest courts are failing to impose compensation orders when convicting people of offences, despite their mandatory-by-default nature. This was the first time the failure to enact this part of the legislation was brought to light. We also were able to draw attention to the data gaps that exist through a failure to properly monitor the legislation’s impact.

2022-s-0411.summaryJa: これは,近代奴隷制に対する英国の対応の不十分さを暴露した共同プロジェクトでした.このプロジェクトは,重要な法律が導入されてから5年以上にわたり,英国における近代奴隷制に対する対応の不十分さを暴露した.これは,データに基づいたいくつかの作品に固定され,英国のニュースルームに設置された8人のジャーナリストのチームからニュース作品や機能を探し求め,構築された. 記事パックをまとめて JPIMediaの地元のニュースルームに共有しました独占的なFOI発見とオープンデータ分析を掲載しタイトルが自分の警察やカウンシルエリアに報道を本地化できるようにしました
2022-s-0411.impactJa: 奴隷制の近代的な法律は犯罪者に犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって奴隷制の象徴となる奴隷制の近代的な法律は犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって犯罪者にとって奴隷制の象徴となる奴隷制の象徴である警官が調査した事件の大部分は起訴をしていない分析によると 2015年以降,19,000件以上の現代奴隷制犯罪で警官が起訴できなかったことが判明しました 20件のうち19件警官は5件のうち4件を失いました容疑者は自由になり有罪判決を受けた者も罰金しか受けずに逃れることが多いのです政治家たちの強い言論にもかかわらず奴隷制の犯罪はイギリスのあらゆる隅に広範囲に広がるだけでなく犯人は罰を受けずにいます報道の自由法要求は,現代奴隷制の犠牲者が賠償を受ける権利を確保するための国際義務を英国がどのように違反しているかを明らかにした. 2015年の法律は,被害者の賠償の重要性を再確認し,奴隷制と人身売買の賠償命令などの新たな措置を導入した.我々が得た数字は,政府によって支援される補償プログラムへの申請者の圧倒的多数が失敗していることを示した. 裁判所は,違反の義務性による違反の性質にもかかわらず,損害賠償命令を課すのを怠っていることを示唆している.この法律のこの部分の施行が未遂になったのは初めてである.また,法律の影響を適切に監視していないことによって存在するデータギャップにも注目することができました.

2022-s-0412.summary: The OpenLux project uncovered years of dubious financial activity involving celebrities, organized crime groups, & people with political connections that had been hidden for years thanks to Luxembourg’s corporate secrecy laws. After Le Monde journalists scraped the data from Luxembourg’s corporate register & worked with OCCRP’s data team to upload it into OCCRP Aleph, our investigative data platform, it became fully searchable for the first time. A global team of journalists investigated the names & companies in the database. Collaborating with 16 media outlets & scores of reporters, we found several instances of elites hiding their business activities from the authorities & public scrutiny.
2022-s-0412.impact: In Luxembourg, the prosecutor has opened at least 12 cases as a result of the OpenLux investigations. The government has committed to putting more people in the prosecutor's office to investigate financial crime. The Luxembourg government put forward a draft bill aimed at allowing authorities to sanction those who use the country’s financial system for money laundering and tax evasion. The law will grant the LBR the power to impose sanctions and relieve the country’s justice system in cases where the registry is abused. “I can confirm that the Minister of Justice will submit to the government a draft bill allowing the Luxembourg Business Register (LBR) to impose administrative sanctions,” Luxembourg Ministry of Justice Press Attaché Monique Feidt told OCCRP. In Serbia, the Openlux investigation created a huge political scandal and forced the president to give an explanation to the press. In Spain, the Openlux investigation connected a former IMF director, Rodrigo Rato, to the company owned by an arms trafficker, Abdul Rahman el Assir. Several EU parliamentarians are using the OpenLux investigation to strengthen the legislation for the next EU directive in terms of requirements for future registers. A month after the publication of the investigation, the European Parliament held a plenary debate titled “Reforming the EU policy framework to stop tax avoidance in the EU after the OpenLux revelations.” A German MEP used OpenLux to press for open company registers after investigation with Indonesian partners showed a palm oil magnate owns a Frank Gehry structure in Dusseldorf — a fact unknown to the German authorities. Reacting to the publication of OpenLux, EU Commissioner Paolo Gentiloni said he is considering an amendment to the anti-tax avoidance directive. European Economic Commission officials requested that a Le Monde reporter explain the revelations from OpenLux.
