2022-s-0453.summaryJa: 保健福祉省のCOVID-19入院データ分析により,私たちは,どの病院が疫情期間中毎週集中治療ユニットを容量に満たしていたかを発見しました.その分析を使用して,我々は,最もストレスの多い病院のリストを作成し,一年以上容量に達した20の病院を特定しました. 病院の医師と看護師と話をして彼らの経験について学びデータを視覚的に文脈にまとめました読者がどの州とどの病院が休憩をしなかったかを読み聞かせました
2022-s-0453.impactJa: 医療従事者,特に過重な病院の医師たちが直面しているストレスについて説明しました.この流行の間,波が来たり去ったりしていたが,これらの病院は,本当の休憩を得ず,流行以来ほぼ常に機能しています.この記事はワクチンに対する躊躇が高まり,公共部門の組合がワクチン要約に積極的に抗議している時期に掲載されました. この話ではワクチン接種が少ない地域と過剰なICUの関係が示されました

2022-s-0454.summary: Plan Your Vaccine was a personalized, interactive digital app that gave Americans trusted information about planning their Covid-19 vaccination for every state and U.S. territory in one place. A team of editors, developers, researchers and designers gathered firsthand information, from requirements by state to locations where the vaccine was being administered, and an option to sign up to receive alerts as changes to eligibility and more changed. After collecting users’ locations, essential groups and ages, the app provided customized information.
2022-s-0454.impact: The page was built in English, Spanish and Mandarin to reach as many readers as possible with real-time information about how to get the vaccine at a time when messages from the government were confusing. At launch, our tool was the only national-scale site of its kind. More than 7 million people got their vaccine information from Plan Your Vaccine, with a reach of 1.6 Billion from broadcast segments. Through social media platforms, we reached 481 million people. More than 120 anchors, correspondents and talent from the larger NBC Universal group shared the tool in more than 10 languages to millions of viewers. Not only was Plan Your Vaccine prominent across digital platforms, but it could be seen on Sunday Night Football, on the Today Show plaza, Telemundo studios, at the Golden Globes, Indy500 and more. Additionally, we worked with the Comcast NBCUniversal Campus Ambassador Program to partner with college students across 52 campuses to post about the tool on social media. Nearly 60,000 people engaged with these organic posts. Media organizations from Bloomberg and Yahoo to People and AdWeek recognized the site for its maximized reach and quick updates. We received inquiries from Google and the White House about how we were able to organize all of the recent locations for our map portion of the tool and potential partnerships. The biggest impact, however, was the impact on everyday people who were struggling to get information about the vaccine for themselves, their parents and grandparents. We received emails and messages from people across the country telling us that by using Plan Your Vaccine they were able to find out exactly when they would be eligible, how to get an appointment and more.

2022-s-0454.impactJa: ウェブサイトは英語,スペイン語,マンダリン語で建設され,政府からのメッセージが混乱しているときに,ワクチンを入手する方法についてのリアルタイム情報でできるだけ多くの読者に届くために作成されました. 当初は,私たちのツールが唯一の全国規模のサイトでした. 7百万人以上の人々があなたのワクチンを計画から入手しました, 放送セグメントから1.6億人のアクセスです. ソーシャルメディアプラットフォームを通じて,私たちは481百万人に届きました. 120人以上のアンカーやコリペンスターやより大きなNBCユニバーサルグループからの才能が,このツールを10以上の言語で数百万の視聴者に共有しました. さらに,私たちはComcast NBCUniversal Campus Ambassador Programと 52校舎の大学生と協力して,このツールについてソーシャルメディアに投稿しましたおよそ60,000人がこれらの有機投稿に関与しましたブルームバーグやヤフから人々とアドウィークへのメディア組織は,その最大限のアクセスと迅速な更新のためにサイトを認識しましたツールや潜在的なパートナーシップの最近の場所のすべてをどのようにして組織できたのかという Googleとホワイトハウスの問い合わせがありましたしかし最大の影響はワクチンに関する情報を得るために苦労していた日常の人たちや親や祖父母への影響でしたワクチン接種計画を利用して適切な時間, 予約の方法などについて正確に知ることができました

2022-s-0455.summary: NBC News analyzed what changed from the first 100,000 Covid deaths in the U.S. to the 100,000 deaths from July to the end of October 2021. This analysis showed key geographic and demographic (racial and age-related) shifts in the evolution of the pandemic, and that analysis coupled with stories of the dead and data visualizations painted a picture for readers of how deaths have changed. What we found: The people who died in the latter 100,000 were younger, whiter and from southern states.
2022-s-0455.impact: This project was read and shared as you would expect a flagship data story such as this would be. These flagship stories aren’t something that you see competing news orgs pick up and re-report immediately — it’s not that easy. Instead, a month after publication, another leading national publication reported out and published their own version of the story, a testament to the value of this way of looking at Covid deaths.
2022-s-0455.authors: Denise Chow, lead reporter Jiachuan Wu, lead visual journalist Jason Abbruzzese, senior editor Anna Brand, senior editor Joe Murphy, lead analyst Francisco Dans, contributing visual journalist Bianca Britton, contributing reporter Chelsea Stahl, art director
2022-s-0455.summaryJa: NBCニュースでは,米国で最初の10万人のCOVID死亡から2021年7月から10月年末までの10万人の死亡に変化した状況を分析した.この分析は,流行の進化における重要な地理的および人口統計 (人種や年齢関連) 変化を示し,死者の物語とデータビジュアライゼーションと組み合わせた分析は,死者がどのように変化したかについて読者にとって絵を描いた. 発見したのは最後の10万人の死者は若い白人で南部の州出身でした
2022-s-0455.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,このようなフラグシップデータストーリーが期待されるように読み取り,共有されました.これらのフラグシップストーリーは,競合するニュース機関がすぐに取り上げ,再報告する物ではありません.その代わりに,出版後1ヶ月,別の主要な全国出版社は報告し,自身のバージョンのストーリーを公開しました. コビッド死亡に対するこの見方の価値の証です.

2022-s-0457.summary: The Covid-19 pandemic has exacerbated pressures on mental health services, with referrals and contacts at their highest. Due to this enhanced pressure, there is a need for scrutinization of mental health services. To fulfil this, I have analysed data, created visualisations and written stories and newsletters around mental illness with the aim to raise awareness and destigmatise mental illness. I achieved this through responsible reporting based on thorough research, involving case studies and professionals, and incorporating data and constructive journalism. The stories were based on exclusive data from FOI requests and official data releases, interviews with vulnerable sources, industry professionals and charities.
2022-s-0457.impact: Through responsible reporting, I was able to raise awareness for issues around mental illness and challenge existing attitudes. I was also shining a light on often underreported topics most readers would never know about. Considering the sources’ vulnerability and the risk of mental illness stigma was crucial. Studies on media coverage of mental health and illness show that the reporting is often stigmatising and negative due to disproportionately focusing on factors such as danger, crime, and violence. This is why I involved people with mental illness in my news stories as this is one way to reduce stigma and to show individual stories behind the data. But at the same time this was one of the main challenges (see answer to other question). Scrutinising mental health service providers is important to uncover issues that are negatively impacting patients. Reporting on them raised awareness and highlighted the potential of improving the situation. Incorporating data and a range of voices made my reporting, although on negative issues, realistic, accurate, informative and balanced – attributes contributing to destigmatising mental illness. To publish more positive and solution-focused stories, I incorporated constructive journalism to discuss possible solutions or promising aspects for a complex social problem. I asked service users and industry professionals about what solutions they think are needed to improve mental health services. In other articles, I included statements from trusts that were positively responding to a situation or featured a charity that was functioning as a role model in transforming mental health wards. The latter illustrating an approach to positively impact mental health wards instead of simply highlighting their bad state.

2022-s-0457.summaryJa: コロビッド-19 流行により精神衛生サービスに対する圧力が悪化し,リファレンスや連絡先が最高水準に達しました.この強化された圧力により,精神衛生サービスについて精査が必要である.これを達成するために,私は精神疾患に関するデータを分析し,視覚化や記事を書きました. 詳細な研究に基づく責任ある報告やケーススタディや専門家の関与, データと建設的なジャーナリズムを組み込むことで達成しました報道は FOIの要請や公式データリリースから得た独占データ,脆弱な情報源,業界専門家,慈善団体とのインタビューに基づいたものです
2022-s-0457.impactJa: 責任ある報道を通じて,私は精神疾患に関する問題に対する意識を高め,既存の態度を挑発することができました.また,多くの読者が知らないあまり報告されていない話題にも光を当てました. 源<unk>脆弱性と精神疾患の汚点のリスクを考えると,極めて重要でした. 精神衛生と病気に関するメディア報道に関する研究によると,報道はしばしば危険性,犯罪,暴力などの要因に不均衡に焦点を当てているため,汚点と否定的なものである.それゆえ,私は精神疾患の患者を私のニュース記事に巻き込んだ.これは汚点を軽減し,データの背後にある個々の物語を示す方法の一つである.しかし同時にこれは主要な課題の一つであった (他の質問への回答を参照). 精神衛生サービス提供者を調査することは,患者に悪影響を及ぼす問題を明らかにするために重要です.これらの問題について報告することは,意識を高め,状況を改善する可能性を強調しました.データとさまざまな声を組み込むことで,私の報告は,否定的な問題について,現実的で,正確で,情報提供的で,バランスの取れたものですが,精神疾患の消極化に貢献しました. 解決に焦点を当てたよりポジティブな記事を公開するために,複雑な社会問題に対する解決策や有望な側面を議論するために建設的なジャーナリズムを組み込みました. サービス利用者や業界専門家に対し,精神衛生サービスの改善に必要な解決策について尋ねました. 他の記事では精神衛生部を変革するロールモデルとして機能する慈善団体や状況に積極的な対応をしている信頼団からの声明を掲載しましたこの記事では精神衛生部を改善する方法が単に悪い状態を強調するのではなく心理衛生部に積極的な影響を与える方法が示されています

2022-s-0458.summary: The Big Tech Lobbying series uses data to help readers understand the enormous lobbying power Big Tech has over policymaking in the US, UK and EU. Stories around lobbying and “sleaze” have dominated the UK news over the past two years, so we wanted to shed light on increasingly sophisticated methods Big Tech uses to wield influence, beyond those we often hear about.
2022-s-0458.impact: The pieces in the series gained wide recognition from academics, those working in tech policy, politicians and activists, and sparked debate on the transparency laws required around declaring lobbying and funding from Big Tech.
2022-s-0458.tools: D3.js, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, R Studio, Svelte

2022-s-0458.summaryJa: Big Tech ロビーリングシリーズでは,読者が米国,英国,EUにおける政策決定にビッグテックの巨大ロビー権力を理解するためにデータを利用しています.ロビーリングやスリーゼに関する話は過去2年間にわたって英国ニュースに支配されているため,私たちはしばしば耳にするもの以上の影響力を発揮するためにビッグテックが利用するますます洗練された方法について光を当てたいと思いました.
2022-s-0458.impactJa: シリーズでは学術学者や技術政策,政治家,活動家から広く認められ,ビッグテックからのロビー活動と資金提供を宣言する際の透明性に関する法律に関する議論が起こりました

2022-s-0459.summary: Based on a vast power plant dataset, we mapped out all new power plants in the development across the world in three interactive data stories, to allow readers to track how the energy transition is taking place around the world in a clear and unique format.
2022-s-0459.impact: The rollout of the trackers coincided with the first week of COP26, providing a unique, data-led and broad perspective on the energy transition at a time when the world's focus was on that very issue. They were some of Energy Monitor's most-read stories of the year, receiving thousands of views and a significant impact across social media.

2022-s-0459.impactJa: 追跡装置の導入はCOP26の最初の週に一致し,世界の焦点がまさにこの問題であった時代に,エネルギー移行に関するユニークなデータ主導で幅広い視点を提供しました.彼らはエネルギーモニターの今年の最も読まれている記事の一部であり,数千件のビューとソーシャルメディアを通じて重要な影響を受けました.

2022-s-0460.summary: This project examined the consequences of clause nine of the British government's proposed Nationality and Borders Bill, which would allow the Home Secretary to strip British nationals of their citizenship without notification under broad conditions. We estimated the number of people who would be affected by clause nine and the relative impact on different ethnicities. This exclusive data analysis was followed up by an in-depth explainer piece, and two further data analyses shedding light on the number of deprivation appeals and the strength of the UK's deprivation powers compared to other G20 countries.
2022-s-0460.impact: The estimate of the number of people affected by clause nine went viral on social media, receiving hundreds of thousands of page views. A follow-up YouTube video on the analysis has received over 100,000 views. The analysis has been cited four times in Parliament and extensively by protesters, as well as by Al Jazeera, the Independent, openDemocracy, Al Araby and the Herald. The overall figure of six million people potentially eligible for deprivation of citizenship was widely cited, as were the figures demonstrating the racially unequal impact — we estimated the clause would affect two in five people from a non-white ethnic minority and half of all British Asians, compared to one in twenty white people.

2022-s-0462.summary: The probability of contracting covid depends strongly on various factors, as shown by numerous studies and data analyses. ZEIT ONLINE has compiled detailed data from ten major German cities for the first time. They show that the coronavirus affects socially disadvantaged people the most.
2022-s-0462.impact: Since Germany lacks detailed Covid data, our analysis showed for the first time: Where many people share an apartment, the Covid rates tend to be higher. This is plausible, since infected people are very likely to infect other people living in the same household. In wealthy neighborhoods, case numbers are comparatively low. Well-paid jobs often take place at a desk and can easily be transferred to the home office, where the risk of infection is low. Unemployment also plays a role: in those neighborhoods where a particularly large number of people do not have a job, there is thus an increased incidence of corona infections.
2022-s-0462.tools: QGIS, CSV, R, R Studio, Node.js
2022-s-0462.authors: Christian Endt, Linda Fischer, Carla Grefe-Huge, Moritz Klack, Julius Troeger
2022-s-0462.summaryJa: 感染する確率は様々な要因に依存している. 多くの研究やデータ分析が示している.ZEIT ONLINEは初めて10の主要なドイツ都市から詳細なデータをまとめました.彼らはコロナウイルスが社会的に最も不利な人々に影響を与えることを示しています.
2022-s-0462.impactJa: ドイツには詳細なCOVIDデータがないため,私たちの分析は初めて示しました:多くの人々がアパートを共有している場所で,COVIDの割合は高くなります.これは確固たるものです.感染した人々は同じ家庭に住む他の人に感染する可能性が高いからです.裕福な近隣では,症例数は比較的低い. 給料が良い仕事がある場合,しばしばデスクで起こります.感染リスクが低い家庭オフィスに簡単に転送できます. 失業も重要な役割を果たしています特に多くの人々が仕事を持たない地域ではコロナ感染の発生率が増加しています

2022-s-0466.summary: The BBC Afghan Service gathered original data on the Taliban advance across Afghanistan and the Visual Journalism team mapped it on an almost daily basis from 9 July - 16 August, showing how districts and cities fell to the insurgents. The maps were widely used on the BBC's UK and world news channels, news online, social media output, and about 40 World Service language sites and services.
2022-s-0466.impact: The maps we made with original data enabled us to tell the unfolding story of the Taliban advance in a visual and timely way, across a range of platforms, providing maximum value for our audience. We used the maps to tell the story of the how districts and provinces initially flipped back and forth between government and Taliban forces in July and then, as momentum built, the relentless advance of the Taliban in the second week of August. The last map we did was on 16 August - the day after Kabul fell and President Ghani had fled - by this time the only area left free of Taliban control was a small part of the Panjshir valley. The maps were used widely in news stories, features and live pages on the website over a six week period, as well as by the BBC’s World and UK News channel and the main TV bulletins on BBC One - the Six and the Ten. We published many of the maps together in our regularly updated Mapping the Taliban feature, which got several million page views. They also featured on social media and nearly all 40 World Service Languages used at least one version of the maps in their coverage.

2022-s-0467.summary: This is the 1st web application revealing the assets, business & network of more than 75 Congress members, chosen by the audience on two open surveys. We exposed their companies, family businesses, state contracts, their networks, and private interests to improve citizens’ decision-making. Indi$cregram: the indiscreet Instagram of power in Colombia. Inspired by the social network, this app informs citizens about really whom they voted for in Congress ahead of the 2022 elections. This tool is based on a methodology to collect, analyze and cross information from 40 public information sources in Colombia and abroad to consolidate around 3500 entities.
2022-s-0467.impact: Due to Juan Diego Gómez’ investigation published on Indi$cregram, the current president of the Senate, sued Claudia Báez and Diana Salinas, co-founders of Cuestión Pública criminally in the Attorney General's Office, alleging slander. Two judges have previously ruled in our favor in two legal actions undertaken by the senator. Cuestión Pública was judicially harassed by two of the congress members under investigation, and we got many reactions by them regarding our revelations on social media. Mainstream medias taken our investigations and put them on the public agenda, also local media republished them regarding their representatives. Three Congress members were forced to launched press released after publication (S1,S2), one of them is a recognized presidential candidate (Petro). Also, 48 people paid membership during publication time (1S), and we increased the membership rate to 10% during the second season. #Indi$cregram is our most visited page in CP history with 261.336 unique pageviews. The project was presented as one of the benchmarks in data journalism at NICAR21, the continent's most important data and research conference organized by IRE in the United States. Indi$cregram was taken as a model to explain what data teams in the U.S. and Europe can learn to do inclusive data journalism. We sent more than 198 (FOIA) to Congress members (two seasons). Thanks to our work to access information (started 2018), at the end of 2019 Colombian Government finally passed a law requiring public officials - Congress members- to publish their income tax returns, asset declarations, and private interests form. We feel it as our own achievement. Thanks to our work and the law we opened, so far, 122 asset declarations, 109 income tax returns, and 76 records of interests of Congress members.

2022-s-0468.summary: Who is poor in a society - and who is rich? Until now, when economists wanted to answer this question, they usually looked at the income of a household. For the interactive calculator "How wealthy are you?" we teamed up with scientists. and built a class calculator that enables every reader to assign himself or herself to a social situation. Two results are central: The gap between the lower and upper social classes has grown significantly in Germany since the 1980s. And: The climb from the bottom to the top is becoming increasingly difficult.
2022-s-0468.impact: We believe we have succeeded in making a new contribution to the poverty and wealth debate in Germany with the class calculator and with the focus. From readers' reactions, we realize that our interactive tool, as well as the reports and interviews, have set in motion a discussion that is just beginning: How is the Corona pandemic shifting social boundaries? What new factors of well-being are already determining who finds it well and healthy through the pandemic? And: What are the consequences if - also due to Corona - social strata harden and become even more impermeable?
2022-s-0468.authors: Paul Blickle, Annick Ehmann, Philip Faigle, Julia Kopatzki, Christopher Moeller, Julian Stahnke, Julius Troeger

2022-s-0469.summary: In a series of agenda-setting investigations, Reuters chronicles the campaign of intimidation carried out by supporters of former President Donald Trump against U.S. election workers, stressing the foundation of American democracy.
2022-s-0469.impact: Federal legislators have drafted new legislation to protect election workers, while lawmakers in Vermont are crafting similar changes. The Federal Bureau of Investigation opened two investigations directly tied to our reports, according to federal law enforcement sources: one into Gjurgi Juncaj, who threatened a Nevada state election official featured in our September story, and another into the anonymous man spotlighted in November who threatened Vermont officials. Later, staff of the U.S. Senate Rules Committee said our coverage helped prompt its leaders to urge the Federal Election Assistance Commission on Nov. 22 to assist election officials around the U.S. in tapping federal money to strengthen security. "Reuters' ongoing reporting on this issue has helped expose the extent and nature of threats against election workers and officials," a senior Rules Committee staffer said.
2022-s-0469.authors: Linda So, Jason Szep, Peter Eisler, John Shiffman, Aram Rostam, Brad Heath, Sam Hart

2022-s-0469.impactJa: 連邦議会は選挙労働者を保護する新しい法律を制定し,ヴェルモント州では同様の変更を策定しています.連邦捜査局は連邦法執行機関情報源によると,我々の報告に直接関連した2件の調査を開始しました. その後,米国上院規則委員会職員らは,我々の報道が,連邦選挙支援委員会に対し,11月22日に選挙当局者に支援するよう促し,安全を強化するために連邦政府の資金を利用するよう促したと述べた. "この問題に関するロイター社の継続的な報告は,選挙職員や官員に対する脅威の規模と性質を明らかにするのに役立ちました"と規則委員会の上級職員の一人が述べた.

2022-s-0470.summary: For almost two years, millions of readers have been informing themselves daily about the current Corona situation directly on the front page of ZEIT ONLINE. They don't need to specific articles, but get all the information from local Covid cases to international vaccination rights at first glance in one tool.
2022-s-0470.impact: 2020 and 2021 are the years in which data journalism became systemically relevant. Never have numbers and their presentation been as important as during the Corona pandemic, never have decisions with such great social relevance been made on the basis of key figures, data and maps. ZEIT ONLINE has found Also ZEIT ONLINE is not content with data at the end of the reporting chain. Since delays, sometimes lasting several days, occur from the health offices via the federal states to the RKI, a team collects the latest figures directly from the websites of the districts. The team provides near-institutional services in the process - and in the process has become a primary source of Covid data.
2022-s-0470.authors: Paul Blickle, Fabian Dinklage, Christian Endt, Rene Engmann, Elena Erdmann, Carla Grefe-Huge, Moritz Klack, Matthias Kreienbrink, Andreas Loos, Valentin Peter, Christopher Pietsch, David Schach, Julian Stahnke, Julius Troeger, Sascha Venohr

2022-s-0470.impactJa: 2020年と2021年はデータジャーナリズムのシステム的な関連性になった年です. 統計とそのプレゼンテーションはコロナ・パンデミックの時ほど重要ではありません. 重要な数字やデータ,地図に基づいて社会的な関連性を持つ決定は一度もありませんでした. また,ZEIT ONLINEは報告のチェーン末端でデータに満足していないことがわかりました. 連邦政府からRKIに渡る医療機関から延期が数日間続くのでチームは地域のウェブサイトから直接最新のデータを収集しますこの過程で組織的なサービスが提供されその過程で COVID データの主な情報源になりました

2022-s-0472.summary: Our exclusive data analysis was published during Canada’s last federal election campaign and was the first news story to put concrete numbers on inequalities between political candidates based on their race and gender. We found that, while all parties recruited more diverse candidates than ever, white men who ran for office still received more money from parties and ran in ridings that were easier to win than racialized and Indigenous candidates. Beyond challenges related to funding and ridings, former and current candidates also shared experiences of racist attacks and discrimination on the campaign trail that discouraged them from running.
2022-s-0472.impact: Our story was addressed by Canada’s Prime Minister Justin Trudeau while on the campaign trail the day it aired. At the time, Trudeau acknowledged that his party could do more to promote and protect candidates who weren’t white. The diversity of the House of Commons in Canada is an important topic that comes up at each election cycle, especially the aspect of race. Before our data analysis and stories were published, that topic was mostly discussed through profiles of candidates or calls to action from various citizen groups, but it wasn’t backed up with hard data. There was also a gap in academic literature and many were looking for a way to maintain accountability on the topic in a credible way every election. Our coverage became a point of reference for groups promoting diversity in all levels of politics. Our analysis and methodology was also noted by many Canadian researchers as an example of what credible data analysis could tell us on diversity in our country. We were even contacted by political science researchers who had read our stories and now had new ideas on how to push this analysis further, including by adding new variables like diving into the professions of political candidates before they ran for office. Lastly, our coverage also shined a light on our own possible shortcomings as media members: many federal candidates gave us concrete examples of times where they felt typecast by news coverage because of their race or were asked biased questions a white candidate would never have to answer by reporters. We shared this feedback with newsroom leaders, which gave us a chance to openly discuss ways to fight our own potential biases and offer better coverage for the 2021 elections.

2022-s-0472.impactJa: 当時のトルードは,彼の党が白人でない候補者を促進し保護するためにもっと多くのことをできる可能性があることを認めた.カナダの下院の多様性は選挙周期ごとに浮上する重要なテーマであり,特に人種の側面です. 私たちのデータ分析と物語が公開される前に,その話題は候補者のプロフィールや様々な市民集団からの行動呼びかけを通じて議論されていましたが,ハードデータで裏付けられませんでした. 学術文献にもギャップがあり,多くの方が,選挙ごとに信頼できる方法でこの話題の説明を保つ方法を探していました. 私たちの報道は,あらゆるレベルの政治で多様性を促進するグループにとって基準となるようになりました. 分析と方法論はカナダの研究者によって注目され信頼性の高いデータ分析が国の多様性について教えてくれる例として注目されました政治家科学研究者が私たちの記事を読んで新しいアイデアを提示しました選挙に参选する前に政治候補者の職業に潜むような新しい変数を追加することで最後に,私たちの報道はメディアメンバーとしての潜在的欠陥にも光を当てました多くの連邦候補者は人種差別によるニュース報道によるタイプcast を感じたときや偏見的な質問を受けたときの具体的な例を示しました白人の候補者はジャーナリストによって絶対に答えなければいけません私たちはニュースルームリーダーとこのフィードバックを共有し 2021年の選挙の潜在的偏見と闘う方法についてオープンに議論する機会を与えました

2022-s-0473.summary: In May 2021, The Economist became the first and only organisation in the world to publish an estimate of the pandemic’s true death toll, as well as estimates of excess deaths for every country in the world. These are, as far as we are aware, the only estimates of excess deaths—the best metric of pandemic mortality, with no dependency on testing—available at the global level. The wider project included a cover “briefing” and a leader calling for more equitable distribution of vaccines, as well as multiple follow-up pieces, an online methodology, and daily-updated interactive tracker.
2022-s-0473.impact: As SARS-CoV-2 spread across the world, it was quickly apparent that some places were better at detecting it than others. Be it in infections or deaths, the biggest difference has always been this: victims in richer countries are more likely to be tested, and therefore more likely to be counted. This matters, because for important questions, such as where to allocate aid or vaccines, or even where to accept travellers from, one needs an accurate picture of the pandemic globally. Such a picture is also important to identify which regions remain vulnerable, and to identify and acknowledge the pandemic’s devastation beyond the rich world. If one relies on official covid-19 death counts, the result is predictable: most victims in poor countries will not be counted, and these countries will not receive help. Our project aims to estimate and show a more accurate representation of the pandemic’s true death toll. The effort has been widely praised by international organisations, such as the WHO, who called it ‘heroic’; the UN who called it “exemplary”; and it has been used as the basis for analysis by the World Bank, as well as being acknowledged the Global Fund, one of the largest distributors of pandemic aid. Researchers at the University of Oxford call it: “the most comprehensive and rigorous attempt to understand how mortality has changed during the pandemic at the global level.” The project’s estimates have been widely used, and have even become part of Our World in Data's covid-19 “data dashboard”. We know that at least one of the world’s largest aid organisations has used our findings in discussions about how to allocate pandemic aid. They are also being used by the WHO and our journalists are regularly advising the WHO on related questions upon request.
2022-s-0473.authors: Sondre Ulvund Solstad, Martín González Gómez
2022-s-0473.summaryJa: 2021年5月,The Economistは世界初の唯一の組織となり,世界各国の超越死亡率の推定値と,この流行病による実際の死亡率の推定値を公表した.これは,我々が知っている限り,世界レベルでの検査に依存することなく,世界最高の流行死率の指標である. 幅広いプロジェクトには,カバーの説明書とワクチンをより公平な配布を要求するリーダーが含まれ,複数のフォローアップパーツ,オンライン方法論,毎日更新されるインタラクティブなトラッカーが含まれていました.
2022-s-0473.impactJa: SARS-CoV-2が世界中で広がるにつれて,一部の地域が他の地域よりも検出に優れていることがすぐに明らかになりました.感染や死亡でも,最大の違いは常にこれでした.裕福な国での犠牲者はテストされやすく,したがって数えられる可能性が高い. これは重要な問題であるため,援助やワクチンをどこに配分するか,あるいは旅行者をどこで受け入れるかといった重要な問題について,世界的なパンデミックについて正確なイメージが必要である.そのようなイメージは,どの地域が脆弱なままであるかを特定し,豊かな世界を超えたパンデミックの破壊を特定し,認識することも重要です. 公式のCOVID-19死亡人数に依拠すれば,結果は予測可能である.貧しい国のほとんどの犠牲者は数えられず,これらの国は援助を受けない.我々のプロジェクトは,この流行の実際の死亡人数の推定とより正確な表現を示することを目指しています. 努力は世界保健機関 (WHO) など,国際機関によって広く評価され,国連は"英雄的な"と称した. 世界銀行が分析の基盤として使用し,世界基金として世界規模で大規模で流行支援を配布している. オックスフォード大学の研究者らは,このプロジェクトによる推定は,世界規模で流行病期間に死亡率がどのように変化したか理解するための最も包括的で厳格な試みである.このプロジェクトの推定は,広く使用され,さらに,CoVID-19の"Our World in Data"のデータダッシュボードの一部となった.我々は,少なくとも世界最大規模の援助機関の一つが,流行病支援の分配方法に関する議論において我々の発見を活用したことを知っている. WHOも利用しており,我々のジャーナリストは,要請に応じて WHOに関連問題について定期的に助言しています.

2022-s-0474.summary: Illustrated History of Knowledge is a series of ten illustrated timelines that explain how certain inventions and fields of knowledge were developed and have changed our way of living. Several scientists from Brazil and abroad were contacted and asked to produce a preliminary script in which the illustrated material would be later based on. The project was a partnership with Instituto Serrapilheira, an institution with the objective of funding research and science communication initiatives.
2022-s-0474.impact: Illustrated History of Knowledge had a very good reception with our readers. We received emails congratulating the initiative, and the average time of reading for each timeline, which measures the retention rate, was almost the double than usual. The project also opened new possibilities for the team to explore the idea of elaborating on the biography of something, not someone, a concept that was later used in other materials (such as the “Biography of Vaccine Producers”, the institutes that produces covid-19 vaccines in Brazil).

2022-s-0475.summary: Palm oil is considered one of the healthiest and most affordable vegetable oils. There's a catch, though: its production comes at the expense of valuable ecosystems. Eco-labels are supposed to help make palm oil more sustainable. But do they deliver what they promise? Our visual investigation finds: only partially. Satellite images and data from Indonesia show that even on certified plantations, illegal clearing techniques and deforestation occur time and again. The online article presents the investigation using maps, graphics, and text. It is accompanied by a short video. The story also appeared in print and on social media.
2022-s-0475.impact: At the beginning of 2021, palm oil became a widely debated topic in Switzerland. The reason for this was the upcoming vote on the free trade agreement with Indonesia. Part of the agreement: Only palm oil with specific sustainability labels should benefit from lower import prices. The vote was approved on March 7. The Neue Zürcher Zeitung (NZZ) was the only media organization that fact-checked the promises made by the sustainability labels in such a detailed analysis. In doing so, we made an essential contribution to the transparency of promises from democratically elected politicians. The story was widely read and well-received by our subscribers. Many of them spent an above-average time on the article online. On social media, the story is still shared on a weekly basis in activist circles to point out the greenwashing issues of the palm oil industry. Internally at Neue Zürcher Zeitung, the article is considered a showcase for using satellite imagery as visual evidence and for investigative research with public data.

2022-s-0475.summaryJa: パームオイルは最も健康的で安価な植物油の一つと考えられていますがひとつは生態系に代わる価値のある生態系です環境ラベルはパームオイルの持続可能性を高めるのに役立つと考えられていますが約束するものを実現していますか? 私たちの視覚調査は部分的に示していますインドネシアからの衛星画像とデータによると認定された植物の場合でも違法なクリアリング技術や森林破壊が繰り返し起こりますオンライン記事では地図,グラフィック,テキストを使って調査を紹介しています.短ビデオが付いています. 物語は印刷版にも,ソーシャルメディアにも出ました.
2022-s-0475.impactJa: 2021年初旬に,パームオイルはスイスで広く議論された話題となった.その理由はインドネシアとの自由貿易協定に関する即興投票だった.合意の一部:特定の持続可能性ラベルを持つパームオイルは,輸入価格を下げる恩恵を受けるべきだった.投票は3月7日に承認された.ニューツルッシャー・ザイュージャーナイト (NZZ) は,持続可能性ラベルがそのような詳細な分析で約束した事実を事実チェックした唯一のメディア機関だった. 民主主義に選ばれた政治家からの約束の透明性を高めるために重要な貢献をしましたこの記事は私たちのサブスクリプションで広く読まれ受け入れられました彼らの多くはオンラインで文章に平均以上時間を費やしましたソーシャルメディアでは,この記事はパームオイルの産業の緑洗浄問題を指摘するために活動家の周回で毎週共有されています内部でニューツーリッハ新聞では,この記事は衛星画像を視覚証拠として使用し,公共データによる調査研究のための展示場として見られる.

2022-s-0476.summary: Is This How the Pandemic Comes to an End? is an interactive explainer on the topic of herd immunity. The piece consists of a calculator, an illustrated scrollytelling element and a simulator. They aim to explain the concept and limitations of herd immunity and answer the question: Can the pandemic be stopped by vaccinating enough people?
2022-s-0476.impact: Back when the project was launched, there was a lot of talk about herd immunity: Would it be possible to stop the spread of the coronavirus just by vaccinating enough people? At the same time however, the new and more contagious delta variant evolved – and rendered the idea of herd immunity virtually impossible. Our calculator and simulator are based on a simple formula that epidemiologists use to estimate how many people would have to be immune in order to stop the spread – and they showed that delta, most likely, had come to stay. The article improved public understanding of a complex but highly relevant topic. It was read and shared widely. Subsequently, the project was translated into English and adapted as a video.

2022-s-0477.summary: He reviews the impact of Covid 19 on the youth of Gaza, for a young man with a disability when he wanted to get medicine, the police stopped him and treated him badly, and the second story of a girl who lost her mother in the war on Gaza in 2014 and during the virus crisis, her family members were injured and fears of loss again lived, the girl Ahlam did not She finds a job in Dubai, and when she returns to Gaza, she is confined to a place that resembles a prison.
2022-s-0477.impact: The project had a great impact on public opinion, especially that the magazine of the International Committee of the Red Cross published it, and it won first place in a competition launched by the International Committee in Palestine, where many activists and pioneers of social networking sites circulated. The report praised the professionalism of the work, especially as it sheds light on a phenomenon that affects the youth group. Noting that the youth category suffers from a high unemployment rate in Gaza that exceeds 50% in light of the lack of job opportunities and the closing of the horizon for young people. There are many crises experienced by young people in the Gaza Strip as a result of several factors, most notably the restrictions of the Israeli siege and the negative effects of the internal Palestinian division, which contributed to the low rates of employment and their absence from political participation, the high costs of marriage and the difficulty of education and transportation to and from the Gaza Strip.

2022-s-0477.summaryJa: 彼は,ガザの若者に対するCOVID19の影響をレビューする,彼は薬を得たいと思ったとき,警察が彼を止め,ひどく扱った,そして2014年にガザ戦争で母親を失った少女の第二の物語,そしてウイルス危機の間に,彼女の家族メンバーが負傷し,再び喪失の恐れが生きていた,少女アハラムはしなかった彼女はドバイで仕事を見つけ,そしてガザに戻ると,彼女は刑務所に似ている場所に閉じ込められている.
2022-s-0477.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,国際赤十字会の雑誌が公開し,国際赤十字会がパレスチナで開設したコンテストで第一位を獲得し,多くの活動家やソーシャルネットワークサイトの先駆者が流通した.このレポートは,仕事のプロフェッショナル性を賞賛した.特に若者グループに影響を与える現象を明るみにする. 青年カテゴリがガザで高失業率で50%を超えていると,雇用機会の欠如と若者の視界の閉ざされたことから指摘する. イスラエルの包囲の制限とパレスチナ内部の分割の悪影響など,ガザの若者が経験する危機は,いくつかの要因により多くあります.これは,雇用の低み,政治参加の欠如,結婚の高コスト,教育とガザの街から移動の困難に寄与した.

2022-s-0479.summary: We created an online tool that enabled people to fill in pre-existing conditions and get the risk of hospitalisation and death for people with those conditions should they get covid-19. Anytime someone uses the tool, a machine learning model running in the cloud is used to generate a prediction. This tool, and the data used to construct it, was also the basis of an investigation into covid-19 illness.
2022-s-0479.impact: Beyond the related publications and the hundreds of thousands who have used the online tool, the project is currently used by academic researchers at Brown, Harvard, New York and other universities, as well as the American Centers for Disease Control (CDC). Researchers at NYU Langone are currently, together with one of our journalists, using the tool to explore how to optimise the allocation of booster doses of vaccine. They have also checked it against their internal data with good results. These researchers turn to us because, as far as they know, no better tool is available.

2022-s-0479.summaryJa: オンラインツールを作りました. このツールによって,人々が既存の条件を満たし,その条件を持つ人々が,COVID-19を感染した場合に病院入院や死亡のリスクを負うことが可能になりました. このツールを使用するたびに,クラウドで実行される機械学習モデルが予測を生成するために使用されます.このツールとそれを構築するために使用されたデータも,COVID-19の病気の調査の基礎でした.
2022-s-0479.impactJa: 関連出版物やオンラインツールを使用した何百万人もの人以外,このプロジェクトは現在,ブラウン,ハーバード,ニューヨークなど大学の研究者,およびアメリカ疾病管理センター (CDC) の学術研究者が利用しています.NYU・ランゴンの研究者らは,我々のジャーナリストの一人と共に,ワクチン補強用量の割り当てを最適化する方法を探索するために,このツールを利用しています. 内部データと比較して成果が良いと確認しました研究者は我々に頼りになりますなぜなら,彼らには,よりよいツールが存在しないからです

2022-s-0481.summary: With the 100th year anniversary of the Tulsa Race Massacre approaching, we wanted to help readers understand the full scope of what was lost when an angry white mob destroyed a thriving Black neighborhood in Tulsa, Okla. We spent months reconstructing the historic neighborhood of Greenwood and created a detailed 3-D model of the area as it was before the massacre. This allowed readers to fully experience the level of success and entrepreneurship accomplished by Greenwood’s Black citizens just six decades out of enslavement.
2022-s-0481.impact: The story of the Tulsa massacre was buried in history for many decades. It is an important piece of American history that we wanted our readers to understand. While historians have pieced together details of the massacre, we wanted to create a fully immersive experience that allowed readers to gain a comprehensive look into the tremendous loss of life, property and generational wealth from the events of May 31 and June 1, 1921. The piece was well received by readers, academics and other media organizations. Hundreds of Times readers not only lauded the project, but for some, it was the first time they had even heard of the massacre. The three lead authors of the project were invited to a number of conferences to speak about the project and how the project came together. Several teachers have reached out to say that the project is being incorporated into their curriculums. And the project has been cited in several academic journals. We also released all of the data files associated with the story to the public so that others could build on the work that we published.

2022-s-0481.jury: The Tulsa massacre, the New York Times has noted, has gone from “virtually unknown to emblematic with impressive speed.” Its own film critics have suggested watching all three new documentaries about the day in 1921 when the entire Black community was burned to the ground by rioting white Tulsa residents, with as many as 300 people killed. The New York Times has now contributed its own groundbreaking work on the massacre, which brings the reader/viewer into the community through a 3D virtual tour. The journalists combed through archival records, interviewed descendants of the families from the community and wrote software to bring the world back to life in a virtual representation. The stunning work is immersive, exhaustive and so impressive and haunting that words fail. By all means, watch all the documentaries on the massacre, but immerse yourself in the Times’ portrait. None of this could have been possible without the expertise of computational journalist with vision.
2022-s-0481.summaryJa: タルサ・ラース・マサックスの100周年を迎えようとしていたので,怒った白人群衆がオクラ州タルサの繁栄した黒人街区を破壊したときに失われたものについて読者に理解してもらいたいと思いました. 私たちは数ヶ月間,グリーンウッドの歴史的な街区を再建し, 虐殺前の地域を詳細に3Dモデルにしました. 奴隷制からわずか6十年後にグリーンウッドの黒人市民が達成した成功と起業家精神を読者たちに完全に体験させました
2022-s-0481.impactJa: タルサ虐殺の物語は数十年もの間歴史に埋まっている.それはアメリカ史の重要な部分であり,私たち読者が理解してほしいと願っていました.歴史家たちは虐殺の詳細をまとめてきたが,私たちは読者に1921年5月31日と6月1日の出来事から生じた膨大な生命,財産,富の損失を全面的に理解できるように完全に浸透した体験を作りたいと思いました. タイムズ誌の読者は,このプロジェクトを褒めてばかりでなく,何人かのために,この虐殺を初めて聞いたことでもあった.このプロジェクトの3人の主要著者は,プロジェクトについて,そしてプロジェクトがどのように結成されたかを話すために,いくつかの会議に招待された.いくつかの教師は,プロジェクトが彼らのカリキュラムに組み込まれていることを伝えました. 複数の学術誌に引用されていますまた公開した作品を活用できるように物語に関連するデータファイルを公開しました
2022-s-0481.juryJa: ニューヨーカー・タイムズは,タルサの虐殺は, 印象的なスピードで,ほとんど未知から象徴的なものへと変化したと記している. 自身の映画批評家は,タルサの白人住民が暴動を起こして,黒人コミュニティ全体が焼却された 1921年の日に 관한3つのドキュメンタリー映画を見ることを提案している. ニューヨーク・タイムズは3D仮想ツアーを通じて読者/視聴者をコミュニティに連れてくるこの虐殺に関する独自の画期的な作品を紹介しました.ジャーナリストはアーカイブ記録を<unk>み,コミュニティの家族の子孫とインタビューし,仮想表現で世界を復活させるソフトウェアを書きました.驚くべき作品は浸透的で,徹底的で,非常に印象的であり,言葉には失敗するほどイカかけます. 虐殺に関するドキュメンタリーを全て観て下さいしかしタイムズ紙の肖像画に浸ってくださいこれらが全て視覚を持つコンピュータジャーナリストの専門知識がなければ不可能でした

2022-s-0482.summary: At the start of the pandemic, international flights have been the area of concern in Canada. But this exclusive analysis demonstrated how tens of thousands of people, some of whom are carriers of the virus that causes COVID-19, travelled across the country every week without testing or quarantine, at time of publication.
2022-s-0482.impact: In Canada, airports are under federal jurisdiction. During the first half of 2021, many provinces tried to stop travellers from entering their territory. However, their powers were limited. They could stop cars at their borders, but they had no control over the planes. At the time, several regions had established curfews or stay-at-home orders. Still, people could take a plane, travel thousands of kilometres in a few hours and land in a restricted area (or leave a restricted area) without being tested and without quarantine upon arrival. Meanwhile, international travellers had to respect stringent rules. Canada was very focused on foreigners, even if there was evidence of inter-provincial contaminations. This exclusive story was among the reports that shifted the focus from international flights to domestic flights. Several provincial prime ministers asked the federal government to close airports or control domestic flights at least. In the end, with the vaccination campaign going on in 2021, the federal government required proof of vaccination to take a plane in Canada.
2022-s-0482.authors: Nael Shiab, Melanie Julien, Santiago Salcido, Martine Roy
2022-s-0482.summaryJa: 流行の始まりに,カナダでは国際フライトが懸念の対象となった. しかしこの独占的な分析は,COVID-19の原因となるウイルスの持ち主である何万人もの人々が,この記事の公開時に,検査や隔離なしで毎週全国を旅していたことを示しました.
2022-s-0482.impactJa: カナダでは空港は連邦管轄権の下にある.2021年上半期には多くの省が旅行者を国境内に送入することを阻止しようとした.しかし,権限は限られていた.彼らは国境で車を止めることができましたが,飛行機を支配することはなかった.当時,いくつかの地域は宵禁や自宅滞在命令を確立していた. 空港で旅行する際には,国際旅行者は厳しいルールを遵守しなければならなかった. カナダは,州間汚染の証拠があったとしても,外国人への非常に集中していた. この独占的な物語は,国際フライトから国内フライトに焦点を移した報告の中でありました. 複数の省内総理大臣は連邦政府に対し,少なくとも空港を閉鎖したり,国内フライトを規制したりするよう求めた. 最終的には,ワクチン接種キャンペーンが2021年に進められ,連邦政府にはカナダで飛行機に乗るのにワクチン接種証明が必要になった.

2022-s-0483.summary: Nearly 9,000 Texas nursing home residents have died of COVID-19. This is what the last year of chaos and isolation was like for nursing homes residents and the employees who care for them.
2022-s-0483.impact: For the first weeks of the pandemic, Texas did not release data on cases in nursing homes — even when it became clear that the virus was especially deadly for residents. With this accountability story, we sought to revisit the lack of transparency, uncertainty and complexity of that period. We used data and people’s stories to show what happened inside nursing homes during the pandemic’s first year. Finding nursing home residents willing (and able) to be interviewed was the biggest reporting challenge. Reporter Karen Brooks Harper spent weeks culling respondents from our COVID-19 callout, reaching out to families and nursing home administrators until she found Lynda Langford, a nursing home resident who became one of the project’s central characters. This story, which gave readers a layer of insight they hadn’t seen before, received positive reception from readers and other news outlets across the state, with data reporter Carla Astudillo appearing on Texas Standard, a statewide public radio program, to tell the story of what we found in the data.
2022-s-0483.tools: D3.js, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, Python, Node.js
2022-s-0483.authors: Carla Astudillo, Karen Brooks Harper and Miguel Gutierrez Jr.
2022-s-0483.summaryJa: テキサス州で 9,000 近くの高齢者ホームがCOVID-19で死亡しました.これは,高齢者ホームの住民と彼らを世話する従業員にとって最後の混乱と孤立の1年でした.
2022-s-0483.impactJa: テキサス州では,この流行の最初の数週間で,高齢者ホームでの症例に関するデータを公開しなかった. ウイルスが住民にとって特に致命的であることが明らかになった時でさえも. この説明責任の物語で,我々はその時代の透明性,不確実性,複雑性の欠如を再考しようとしました. 私たちはデータと人々の物語を使用して,流行の最初の年に介護施設内で何が起こったかを示しました. インタビューを受けたい (そして受けたい) 介護施設の住民を見つけることが最大の報告課題でした.記者カーレン・ブルックス・ハーパー氏は,COVID-19の調査から回答者を切り離し,家族や介護施設管理者に連絡をかけて,プロジェクトの中心的なキャラクターとなった介護施設の住民のリンダ・ランフォードを見つけました. この記事では読者がこれまで見たことのない洞察の層を与えました州中の読者や他の報道機関からポジティブな反応を受けましたデータ記者カーラ・アストディロがテキサス・スタンダードに出演し州全体の公共ラジオ番組でデータを紹介しました

2022-s-0484.summary: Public data is everywhere, collected by government agencies, advocacy groups, news organizations and an ever-expanding set of specialty sites. But that data is online in too many different locations to easily search. The Accountability Project cuts across these data silos and give journalists and the public a simple way to search huge volumes of public data about people and organizations. So far, we’ve acquired, standardized and uploaded hundreds of databases, accounting for more than 1.4 billion records. The data has been used by journalists across the country to identify patterns and draw connections between people and organizations.
2022-s-0484.impact: The goal of TAP was to provide research data to newsrooms and researchers that might otherwise not have access to such data. We have worked with several nonprofit newsrooms to help them with investigations using TAP data, including stories about dark money, nonprofits and health care. We have nearly 20,000 unique users with more than 400 sign-ups for the data that requires a logon. Because the site is free, it is difficult for us to track how individual searches generate stories, but anecdotally, users say it is an valuable resource.
2022-s-0484.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, R Studio, PostgreSQL, Node.js

2022-s-0484.summaryJa: 公共データはあらゆる場所であります. 政府機関,擁護団体,ニュース機関,そしてますます拡大する専門サイトによって収集されています. しかし,そのデータは簡単に検索できないほど多くの異なる場所でオンラインです. アカウントビリティプロジェクトではこれらのデータサイロを切り抜き,ジャーナリストや一般市民が人々や組織に関する膨大な公共データの検索を簡単な方法として提供しています. これまで,私たちは140億以上の記録を記録する何百ものデータベースを入手し,標準化し,アップロードしました.このデータを,全国各地でジャーナリストがパターンを見つけ,人々と組織とのつながりを図るために利用しています.
2022-s-0484.impactJa: TAPの目的は,他の方法ではそのようなデータにアクセスできないニュースルームや研究者に研究データを提供することでした. TAPのデータを使用した調査で,ダークマネー,非営利団体,医療に関するストーリーを含むいくつかの非営利ニュースルームと協力しました.ログインを必要とするデータには400人以上の登録を持つ約2万人のユニークなユーザーがあります. サイトが無料なので個々の検索がストーリーを生成する方法を追跡するのは難しいのですがユーザーによるとこれは貴重なリソースです

2022-s-0485.summary: In late 2020, Major League Baseball announced that it will be officially recognizing the statistics of around 3,400 players who played in seven Negro Leagues between 1920 to 1948. This project is an interactive exploration of the players from the Negro Leagues. The piece displays characteristics and skills from all NLB players and provides contextual comparisons to modern/active MLB players to help readers learn about them.
2022-s-0485.impact: With the inclusion of Negro League statistics in the overall statistical world of Major League Baseball, we wanted to tell the stories of these players and their impact on the game. The goal was to put them in context of the players MLB has long-touted and help readers understand that they should have known these incredible Black players all along. We wanted to give these statistics to our stats-minded audience but also make sure that the players were understood as more than just their statistics. This piece was featured far and wide including across ABC News properties, ESPN, The Ringer and NPR.
2022-s-0485.authors: Jay Boice, Neil Paine, Anna Wiederkehr, Emily Scherer, Sara Ziegler, Santul Nerkar
2022-s-0485.summaryJa: 2020年下旬,メジャーリーグ野球は1920年から1948年にかけて7つの黒リーグでプレーした3400人の選手の統計を公式に承認すると発表した.このプロジェクトは黒リーグの選手のインタラクティブな探索である.この作品は,すべてのNLB選手の特徴とスキルを表示し,読者がそれらについて学ぶのを助けるために,現代/アクティブ MLB選手に文脈比較を提供します.
2022-s-0485.impactJa: メジャーリーグ野球の統計の世界に黒人リーグの統計を組み込むことで,我々はこれらの選手の物語とゲームへの影響を伝えたいと考えました.目標は,MLBが長い間宣伝してきた選手の文脈にそれらを置くことであり,読者がこの素晴らしい黒人選手をずっと知っていたはずだと理解するのを助けることでした. 統計学的な観客にこの統計を伝えたいのですが選手は単なる統計以上のものだと理解されることを確認したいのですがこの作品は ABCニュース,ESPN,The Ringer,NPRなどで広く紹介されました

2022-s-0486.summary: Anyone who rents a room anywhere in The Netherlands, quickly pays 500 euros per month for just about 10 square meters, sometimes even 1000,-. Square meters that are too expensive, because according to the rental law rooms belong to the social rental sector. A points system has been designed for this, which determines the maximum rent. Argos built a scraper. We analyzed all rooms on Kamernet, the largest provider in the Netherlands. Many landlords appear to be flouting the law. We discovered that 8 of 10 rooms are (much) too expansive.
2022-s-0486.impact: This story has been picked up by more 100 news outlets in The Netherlands. Not only did almost every major newspaper and news website publish the news, but because the results were presented per city, many local media have written their own story from it. RTL News, one of the largest broadcasters in The Netherlands, broadcasted a TV item on their 18.00 hours news program. A tv documentary has also been made from it Parliamentary questions have been asked to the minister of Home Affairs. We made an English translation of our project, we will send this to your organisation via e-mail tomorrow. In case you have any question, you can e-mail us at r.tromp@vpro.nl
2022-s-0486.tools: Scraping, Json, Microsoft Excel, CSV, Python
2022-s-0486.summaryJa: 賃貸法によると,賃貸の部屋は社会賃貸部門に属しているため. このためにポイントシステムが設計されています. Argosは最大賃貸を決定します. スクラッパーを建てました. 私たちはすべての部屋を分析しましたカメネット,オランダ最大のプロバイダーです. 土地所有者が法律を無視しているようです 8室から10室が広すぎるのが発見しました
2022-s-0486.impactJa: このニュースはオランダの100以上のニュース・アウトレーターによって集まった. 大手新聞やニュースウェブサイトがニュースを公開するだけでなく,結果が各都市に発表されたため,多くの地方メディアが自社のニュースを書いた.オランダ最大の放送会社であるRTLニュースが18時ニュース番組でテレビ番組を放送した. 議会の質問は内務省に聞かれました. 私たちは我々のプロジェクトの英語翻訳をしました. 私たちは明日メールであなたの組織に送ります.

2022-s-0487.summary: We built an election forecasting model to assess the uncertainty in political polling and project the outcome of Germany’s parliamentary election, and followed the election through to its ultimate result.
2022-s-0487.impact: The model helped us frame the election and put its swings and surges in context. Our readers could follow not only the polls but also how they were likely to change as the election neared, and get a preview of the inevitable coalition discussions that followed the vote. Germany’s multi-party system is complex, and the model was able to cut through some of its complexity. It could reveal, for example, which parties were likely to gain or lose at others’ expense. In this way, it helped inform the rest of our coverage, giving our reporters a real-time sense of how the dynamics of the election changed as the campaign progressed.
2022-s-0487.authors: G. Elliott Morris, Evan Hensleigh, Matt McLean, Patrick Lane
2022-s-0487.summaryJa: 選挙予測モデルを構築し政治投票の不確実性を評価しドイツ議会選挙の結果を予測し最終的な結果まで選挙を追跡しました
2022-s-0487.impactJa: モデルが選挙を枠組みにまとめ波動と上昇を文脈にまとめました読者は選挙が近づくにつれて投票がどう変化するかを観察し投票の後 inevitable 連合の議論の予見を入手しましたドイツの多党制は複雑でモデルがその複雑性の一部を切り抜けることができました例えばどの政党が勝負するか否かを明らかにできます報道の残りの部分に情報を伝えて選挙運動が進むにつれて選挙の動態が変化したリアルタイムで報道者に知ってもらいました

2022-s-0488.summary: Social networks are fundamentally changing public debate. Polarizing content is favored, micro-targeting makes it possible to send messages to categories of the population, and party spending has exploded, particularly so in our country Belgium. Our project is based on data from the Facebook ads library and on crowdsourced data from users. We have treated the data in a way that allows the public to understand the issues at stake, and to tell a story based on numerous sources, including top politicians. Additionally, a newsgame allows the reader to put him/herself in the shoes of a political community manager.
2022-s-0488.impact: When the size of political spending on Facebook was revealed, compared to other EU countries, thanks to the work of the Ad-Lens collective which we are a part of, it created a bit of a shock, and an important debate has taken place in Belgium, mostly on social media. The political parties involved are avoiding the debate, because they have an interest in the status quo. However, a hearing was organized in the national parliament on the issue.
2022-s-0488.tools: Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV

2022-s-0489.summary: The investigation into the sale of passports as a legalised transaction exposes what happens when applicants attempt to purchase their way into EU citizenship through Malta’s passport sales scheme: • the ‘genuine links’ requirement (a physical residency workaround) is a box-ticking exercise; • the residency loophole enables buyers to obtain citizenship without spending any significant time in the country; • applicants are typically from particular jurisdictions and categories and include an MP, oligarchs, royalty, and fugitives; • select applicants received special treatment, including privileged access to former PM Joseph Muscat; • Henley & Partners had written agreements with Cambridge Analytica and its CEO, Alexander Nix.
2022-s-0489.impact: The Passport Papers showed that the sale of citizenship has a real and direct impact on European states and their citizens. The story was picked up by mainstream news media and specialist media across the US, Europe, and Asia. It prompted a reaction by an EC spokesperson (“EU values are not for sale...granting EU citizenship without a genuine link violates EU law”), and fed into the EP plenary debate on the rule of law in Malta (“Parliament is deeply concerned about the harmful impact of citizenship and residence schemes on the integrity of EU citizenship, and reiterates its call on the Maltese government to assure transparency and terminate its schemes”), leading to EP resolution 2021/2611(RSP) calling “on the Maltese authorities to assure transparency and terminate its investor citizenship and residence schemes rather than modify them.” In Malta, the Passport Papers provoked a defensive reaction from the government and public outrage on social media. Aditus, an NGO that assists undocumented migrants and asylum seekers, said the “The exposé on the "genuine link" requirement and how this is established, flies in the face of the difficulties faced by non-Maltese who apply for citizenship by naturalization.” Repubblika, a rule of law NGO, issued a 43- page position paper calling for the passport sales scheme to be scrapped, and for wide-ranging reforms in the administration of citizenship. Henley&Partners responded with legal letters accusing the Foundation of retaining “stolen data” in a “criminal database” and - unsuccessfully - demanding its deletion. The Passport Papers investigation is ongoing.

2022-s-0490.summary: The housing problem in Lisbon, how the pandemic affected Algarve’s tourism industry, and climate change. Portugal went to the polls in September to elect 308 mayors. At Público we wanted to answer a simple question: is it possible to have a future here? We used data to find the municipality that was more affected by these issues - even though they were simply representative of a national problem. Then, a team of reporters went to these places to understand the local reality, and how it is affecting people's lives. And what the different candidates were proposing to solve it?
2022-s-0490.impact: The three articles all began with a close-up on the data available in Portugal, highlighting the region of the country that has a deeper problem - and thus begins the reporting there. We decided that using scrollytelling we were able to write a “story before the story” - explaining that the issue is being felt all over the country, but that some regions are being affected way more than others. Every piece also included a small news app that allowed people to explore the data to their local municipality, showing them how close the place they live is similar to that place. That was the most praised thing by our readers: suddenly, a local story became way more interesting to the whole country because 1) we were showing that the country, as a whole, was being affected by it and 2) that the place where the reader had the same problem, but probably in a smaller scale.

2022-s-0490.summaryJa: リスボンにおける住宅問題,この流行がアルガルベの観光産業,気候変動に影響を与えた方法.ポルトガルでは9月に308人の市長を選びました. そして,あるジャーナリストのチームがこの地域を調査し, 現地の現実を理解し,人々の生活にどう影響を与えているかを調べました. そして,その解決を提案する候補者は?
2022-s-0490.impactJa: 記事の3つもポルトガルで利用可能なデータについて近くで調べて国の地域がより深い問題があることを強調し報告がそこで始まるのですそこで私たちはスクロール・テリングを使ってストーリー・ビーン・ストーリー (<unk>story before the story) を書き上げることができましたこの問題は全国で感じられているが地域が他よりも影響を受けていることを説明しました記事にはまた小さなニュースアプリが含まれていましたそのアプリは人々に地元の自治体のデータを調べて住んでいた場所がその場所とどの程度近いかを示しましたそれが読者の最も褒められたことです突然地元の物語が国の全体にとって興味深いものになりましたなぜなら (1) 私たちはその国の全体がその影響を受けていたことを示し (2) 読者の場所が同じ問題があったが規模が小さくなったからです

2022-s-0491.summary: Agência Pública analyzed data from more than 8.5 million people that had been vaccinated in Brazil up to that moment and found out that the number of white people that had gotten the vaccine was double that of black people. This inequality remained when looking at the vaccination rate inside each ethnic group: less than 2 out of 100 black people had received their first covid shot, while more than 3 out of 100 white people had gotten their first jab. At the same time, data revealed that proportionally there were 10% more deaths from Covid-19 among black people.
2022-s-0491.impact: After the article was published, our team was invited to present the report at a meeting of the National Health Council that discussed Brazil's vaccination plans. Afterward, the National Health Council published a document calling for the adoption of anti-racist actions regarding access to health care by the Ministry of Health, state and municipal health secretariats and councils. The article was among the finalists for the 2021 Brazilian Conference on Data Journalism, Coda Awards. It was also republished by 33 websites and media outlets, in Portuguese and Spanish. Moreover, we have registered through the BuzzSumo platform more than 90 citations and backlinks of the story in national and international websites and media organizations, including The World, Newsweek and RTP (Rádio e Televisão de Portugal).

2022-s-0491.summaryJa: 公共機関がブラジルでワクチン接種を受けた850万人以上のデータを分析しワクチンを接種した白人の人口は黒人の2倍だと発見しましたこの不平等はどの民族の間で接種率を見ても残りました 100人の黒人より2人未満が COVID-19の最初のワクチン接種を受け 100人の白人より3人が最初のワクチン接種を受けていました同時にデータによると黒人人のうちコVID-19による死亡率は10%増加しました
2022-s-0491.impactJa: 論文が公表された後,私たちのチームはブラジルでのワクチン接種計画を議論した国立保健評議会の会議で報告を提示するよう招待されました. その後,国立保健評議会は保健省,州および市立保健事務局および評議会による医療へのアクセスをめぐる反人種差別的な措置の採択を要請する文書を公表しました. 記事は2021年のブラジルデータジャーナリズム会議,コダ賞の最終候補者でした. また,ポルトガル語とスペイン語で33のウェブサイトとメディア・アウトレーットによって再発行されました. さらに,我々は,ポルトガル・ラジオ・テレビ (The World,Newsweek,RTP) を含む国内・国際ウェブサイトやメディア組織で記事の90以上の引用とバックリンクを登録しました.

2022-s-0492.summary: This timeline tracks COVID-19’s rampage through Texas in its first year: the growing death toll, the policy decisions made in response to the pandemic that often influenced its course and the stories of some of the Texans claimed by the virus. Pressed flowers are shown throughout to represent lives lost.
2022-s-0492.impact: Every day from April 2020 to May 2021, the Texas Tribune’s data visuals team published a coronavirus case tracker. As the numbers grew, we realized we were feeling numb to the scale of the tragedy. This project about the people who died was an effort to bring humanity back into those statistics. After publishing this, we heard from readers who had lost a relative to coronavirus — they deeply appreciated how much care we took in telling this story. This is the best feedback we’ve ever received on a project, and we believe it’s because the story came from a place of deep empathy for its subjects.
2022-s-0492.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Canvas, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, Python, Node.js
2022-s-0492.authors: Mandi Cai, Emily Albracht and Chris Essig
2022-s-0492.summaryJa: このタイムラインは,最初の年にテキサス州で発生したCOVID-19の暴動を追記しています. 死亡人数が増え,流行病に反応してしばしば影響を与えた政策決定,そしてウイルスが主張したテキサス人の物語です. 圧縮された花は,失われた命を代表する.
2022-s-0492.impactJa: 2020年4月から2021年5月までの毎日,テキサス・トリビューンのデータビジュアル・チームがコロナウイルス病例追跡調査を公開しました.数字が増加するにつれて,私たちは悲劇の規模に鈍感を感じることを認識しました.亡くなった人々に関するこのプロジェクトは,人類を再びその統計に引き込むための試みでした.これを公開した後,私たちはコロナウイルスに親戚を失った読者から聞いた.彼らはこの話を伝えるのにどれだけ注意を払ったかを深く評価しました. これは私たちがこれまでプロジェクトについて受け取った最高のフィードバックです物語は主題に対する深い思いやりから出来ているからです

2022-s-0493.summary: The results of Canadian general elections are usually available during the night. We decided to create a unique 3D project to explain the results to our readers who would check the news in the morning.
2022-s-0493.impact: Many readers wrote to us saying how much they enjoyed their experience. It's difficult to propose something different than usual for topics that keep recurring. Some expectations need to be fulfilled, especially for events of importance like elections. For these projects, the space to innovate is narrow. But based on the readers' feedback, we succeeded in presenting electoral results on a map in a new and engaging manner with this project.
2022-s-0493.authors: Nael Shiab, Melanie Julien, Francis Lamontagne, Mathieu St-Laurent, Martine Roy
2022-s-0493.summaryJa: カナダの総選挙の結果は通常夜中に入手できますそこで私たちは 3D プロジェクトを制作し午前中にニュースをチェックする読者に結果を説明することにしました
2022-s-0493.impactJa: 多くの読者が私たちに手紙を書いて,自分の経験がどれだけ楽しかったかを伝えました. 繰り返し話題にいつもとは違うものを提案するのは難しい. 特に選挙のような重要なイベントでは,期待を満たす必要がある. これらのプロジェクトでは,革新する空間は狭い. しかし,読者のフィードバックに基づいて,私たちは新しい,魅力的な方法で選挙結果を地図上に提示することができました.

2022-s-0494.summary: In one month in 2021, Texas lawmakers redrew political maps for the state’s congressional, House, Senate and Board of Education districts. The maps were drawn to keep Republicans in power for the next decade. The maps entrench rural, white electoral power — despite new census numbers pointing to Texans of color as the main force behind the state’s population growth. This tool allows readers to search their address to see how the new districts will affect their community.
2022-s-0494.impact: During a whirlwind one-month special legislative session in the fall of 2021, Texas lawmakers redrew the state’s political maps. The process is opaque and inaccessible but impacts every resident, including the millions of Texans of color who are the main force behind the state’s population growth. This project was designed to show readers exactly how the districts they live in were redrawn, and they appreciated it. Reader feedback included: - A reader named Gabe was effusive over twitter: "This is legit one of the coolest/most useful things I've see" (https://twitter.com/TxGabeGrantham/status/1451559468647473152) - Other people on twitter called this "great", and still others said it was "fantastic work", "well executed", a "great tool", "excellent tool", "incredible tool", "really, really helpful" - Jack noted "This is so much better and more user friendly than the state’s map. Bless you Texas Tribune " (https://twitter.com/jflagler/status/1451598277103788036) - The Houston Bureau Chief for The New York Times called it "a cool and very useful tool" - Several state lawmakers shared it, noting how helpful it was - A Reddit reader thanked us for all the work we've done on this topic
