2022-s-0494.summaryJa: テキサス州議会,上院,教育委員会が選出する州議会,議会,教育委員会などに関する政治地図を2021年1月1日 (月) に改定した.この地図は,共和党が今後10年間政権を維持するために作成された.新人口普查の数字が州の人口増加の背後にある主要な力として,色彩のテキサスを指しているにもかかわらず,地図は農村部の白人選挙権力を強化している.このツールにより,読者は新しい地区がコミュニティに影響を与える方法を見るために彼らの住所を検索することができます.
2022-s-0494.impactJa: テキサス州議会は2021年の秋に開催された"ヶ月間の特別立法会議で,テキサス州議会が州の政治地図を再編した.このプロセスは不透明でアクセスできないが,州の人口増加の背後にある主要な力となる色彩の数百万人のテキサス人を含むすべての住民に影響を与える.このプロジェクトは,彼らが住んでいる地区がどのように再編されたかを正確に読者に示すために設計された.そして彼らはそれを評価した. 読者のフィードバックは以下が含まれています. - ガベという読者はツイッターで熱心に語った. "これは私が見た中で最もクール/最も有用な物の一つです" (https://twitter.com/TxGabeGrantham/status/1451559468647473152) - ツイッター上の他の人々はこれを"素晴らしい"と称し,他の人々は"素晴らしい仕事"と称し, "うまく実行された"と称し, "素晴らしいツール", "優れたツール", "信じられないようなツール", "本当に,本当に役立つ"と称した. ニューヨーカー・タイムズのヒューストン・オフィス・シフは"クールで非常に有用なツール"と称した. 複数の州議員が,それがどれほど役立つかを指摘し,それを共有した.

2022-s-0495.summary: Paradoxically, the costs of the global medical system fell during the Covid period: the redistribution of funds to counteract the pandemic and the reluctance of people to go to the hospital for other medical conditions meant less money spent in hospitals. However, the real costs of this phenomenon will be seen in the coming years, health experts point out. Then all the undiagnosed conditions due to the pandemic will suffocate the medical system. The article aims to map out the medical budgets of every EU member state by the source of origin and destination and explain the situation on a national level.
2022-s-0495.impact: Analyzing and combining the country level data and representing it in one single chart helps us understand that: There are huge differences in allocations between European countries. In absolute terms, Germany has advanced the highest funds to fight the pandemic (34.6 billion euros). At the other end of the spectrum is Croatia, which has officially allocated an additional € 53 million. The highest additional per capita allocations was in Austria (EUR 3,111 per capita) and the lowest in Croatia (EUR 12.5 per capita). Austria also ranks first if we interpret the additional allocations as a percentage of the usual health budget, with 70%. At the bottom of the rankings, France increased its budget by only 0.75% of its pre-pandemic budget. However, Paris plans to invest heavily in the health care system, but so far the allocations have not been included in the 2020 and 2021 budget years, so they cannot be taken into account in this analysis. Romania and Bulgaria are the last countries in the additional per capita allocations, with 42 and 33 euros, respectively. The same two countries are among the "leaders" in the mortality rate among patients infected with Covid-19, being surpassed only by Italy, where the pandemic profile was atypical compared to the rest of Europe in the context of the aging population.
2022-s-0495.summaryJa: paradoxically,the costs of the global medical system fell during the Covid period: the redistribution of funds to counteract the pandemic and the reluctance of people to go to the hospital for other medical conditions meant less money spent in hospitals. However, the real costs of this phenomenon will be seen in the coming years, health experts point out. Then all the undiagnosed conditions due to the pandemic will suffocate the medical system. この記事は,EU加盟国の医療予算を源泉と目的地からマッピングし,国家レベルでの状況を説明することを目的としています.
2022-s-0495.impactJa: 国のレベルデータを分析し組み合わせて単一のチャートで表現することで理解できます欧州諸国間の配分に大きな差があるのです絶対的な観点から言えばドイツは大流行対策に最も高い資金を調達しました (34.6億ドル) 反対側には公式に追加5300万ユーロを配分したクロアチアがありますオーストリアは,通常の健康予算の70%で,追加予算を解釈すると,オーストリアも第一位を占めています. ランキングの底部では,フランスはその前流行予算の0.75%で予算を増加させた. しかし,パリは医療システムに大きく投資を計画しているが,これまでの予算は2020年と2021年の予算に含まれていないため,この分析では考慮できない.ルーマニアとブルガリアはそれぞれ42ユーロと33ユーロで,一人当たりの追加的な割り当てで最後の国である. 同じ2カ国はCOVID-19感染者の死亡率を"リード"している一方で,イタリアだけが超えている.

2022-s-0496.summary: With this tool, we have compiled the full text of all requests for impeachment against Jair Bolsonaro, as well as a summary of each proposal and exclusive interviews with its authors. The initiative is part of Agência Pública's commitment to the pursuit of transparency and accountability of all branches of government and public authorities. The tool also features the requests sorted by topic. Bolsonaro's poor handling of the health crisis during the pandemic and the government's delay in buying the covid-19 vaccines are among the most recurrent topics.
2022-s-0496.impact: Agência Pública has been monitoring all impeachment requests filed with the Chamber of Deputies and making them publicly accessible on the tool. Although the project was created in the second semester of 2020, most of its content is from 2021, when there were 82 new requests. By gathering these documents in a single platform, we promote transparency, making it easy for any citizen to have direct access to the information. We also translate legal terms into less formal language in the abstracts of each request and publish interviews with the plaintiffs.The impeachment tool is a pioneering initiative, both in the field of journalism and public transparency. It is an important historical record, serving as a data source for journalists and researchers. Through the BuzzSumo platform, we have so far registered more than 140 citations or backlinks to the tool in national and international websites, such as Reporters sans frontières, and major media outlets such as the New York Times, Bloomberg and Foreign Policy. The tool was also cited in "How to remove a president: Theory, history, and practice of impeachment in Brazil", a book by researcher and professor at the University of São Paulo Rafael Mafei. With this project, we were able to determine that Bolsonaro is the president who has accumulated the most impeachment requests in Brazil's history - already more than 140 requests. We were also able to analyze the range of accusations on which the petitions are based. More than 1550 people and more than 500 organizations have signed the petitions. Agência Pública's impeachment tool is also an instrument of citizenship. Using the tool, our readers have already sent 16.697 emails demanding a follow-up to the President of the Chamber of Deputies, who has so far ignored the documents.
2022-s-0496.authors: Natália Viana, Mariama Correia, Laura Scofield, Ethel Rudnitzki, Raphaela Ribeiro, Beatriz Carneiro, Babak Fakhamzadeh
2022-s-0496.summaryJa: このツールにより,我々はJair Bolsonaroに対する弾<unk>のすべての要請の全文をまとめ,それぞれの提案の概要と著者との独占的なインタビューをまとめました.このイニシアチブは,公共機関が政府や公権機関のすべての部門の透明性と説明責任を追求するコミットメントの一部です.このツールには,またテーマによって分類された要請が表示されます. ボルソナロが疫情期間中健康危機をうまく管理し,政府がCOVID-19ワクチンを購入するのを遅らせることは最も頻繁に話題になっている.
2022-s-0496.impactJa: 公務員庁は,議会に提出されたすべての弾<unk>請求を監視し,その文書を公開して利用している.このプロジェクトは2020年2半期に作成されたものの,そのコンテンツの大半は2021年から,82件の新しい請求があった.これらの文書を単一のプラットフォームに集めることで,我々は透明性を促進し,市民に情報への直接アクセスを容易にする. 起訴ツールはジャーナリズムと公的透明性の分野の両方で先駆的な取り組みです. 重要な歴史的記録であり,ジャーナリストと研究者にとってデータ源として機能しています. BuzzSumoプラットフォームを通じて,我々は,Reporters sans frontièresなどの国内外のウェブサイトやニューヨークタイムズ,ブルームバーグ,Foreign Policyなどの主要なメディアで140以上の引用やバックリンクを登録しました. このツールも"How to remove a president: Theory, history, and practice of impeachment in Brazil"で引用されました. このプロジェクトにより,我々はボルソナロがブラジル史上最も多くの弾<unk>請求を集めた大統領であることを決定することができました - すでに140件以上です.また,この請願の根拠となる指控の範囲を分析することができました.1550人以上の人々と500以上の組織が請願に署名しました.公共機関の弾<unk>請求ツールも市民権の道具です. ツールを利用して,私たちの読者は既に 16697件のメールを送り, 議会議員議会議員議長にフォローアップを要求しました.

2022-s-0497.summary: House prices have been a problem all across Europe, with Portugal being particularly hit by the increase of those prices. Even though that’s something everyone in the country is aware of (and worried about), the news cycle only allowed journalists to focus on the When and What, but never on the Who and the Why. Why is it so hard to rent an apartment? And is everyone being affected in the same way?
2022-s-0497.impact: Our team, in collaboration with the academic contributors, built a tool that aimed to let people know where they could afford to rent with their income. Because of the level of personalization that this interactive feature gives to the readers, even people who already own a house in some places can put themselves in the shoes of someone who is trying to rent a house in the country. We believe that this level of personalization was the key to its success. The article received more than 800 interactions on Facebook and was shared by pages like the Lisbon Tenants Association, meaning that people being affected by the problem were able to understand it better. Because the article was co-authored with two academic researchers, it was also a spark to ignite the debate between economists and other researchers in the field.
2022-s-0497.tools: Personalisation, D3.js, Json, CSV, R, R Studio
2022-s-0497.authors: Luísa Pinto, Rui Barros, Loraine Vilches, Gabriel Sousa, Sílvia Jorge, Aitor Varea Oro
2022-s-0497.summaryJa: 住宅価格はヨーロッパ全土で問題となりポルトガルでは特に価格上昇が影響していますこの国の誰もが知っていること (そして心配していること) があったとしても,ニュースサイクルではジャーナリストが何と何に集中するしかなかったが,誰がなぜそう難しいのか. なぜアパートを借りるのはそんなに難しいのか? そして,誰もが同じように影響を受けているのか?
2022-s-0497.impactJa: 私たちのチームは学術的な貢献者と協力して収入でどこに賃貸できるのか情報を伝えるツールを作りましたこのインタラクティブな機能が読者に与えるパーソナライゼーションのレベルから土地で家を借りようとしている人の立場に居られる人もいますこのパーソナライゼーションのレベルがその成功の鍵だと信じていますこの記事はFacebook上で800件以上のインタラクションを受け取り,リザボンの賃貸者協会のようなページで共有されました. つまり問題の影響を受ける人々はよりよく理解することができました. この記事は学術研究者の2人と共同執筆されたため,経済学者と他の研究者の間で議論を起こす火花でした.

2022-s-0498.summary: Inhaling Smoke is a special project that investigates the effects of air pollution caused by wildfires on the health of the Brazilian Amazon population during the pandemic. This toxic synergy was the object of an unprecedented data analysis carried out by a multidisciplinary team of journalists, geographers, statisticians and scientists. We analysed satellite data to determine which locations were most affected by air pollution during the 2020 wildfires and how it impacted the health of amazonians. Smoke was related to an 18% increase in severe cases of Covid and 24% increase in hospitalizations for respiratory syndromes in the 5 most affected states.
2022-s-0498.impact: The relevance of this project is to show the relationship between two seemingly disconnected events (fire and Covid), highlighting how environmental and public health issues are closely linked. The data reveals how the pollution from the Amazon fires has a perverse effect on the population that is explained by a specific geography of fire - the most affected municipalities, in different states, indicate the expansion of the arc of deforestation. Through extensive data analysis, the project was able to quantify the impact of fire-attributable pollution on the worsening of Covid cases, providing subsidies both for the reader to understand the gravity of the environmental crisis and for the government to make decisions based on the data. The importance of a project like this in 2021 is similar to a large-scale post-mortem examination, bringing evidence and proof of the devastation of the Amazon and how this affects its citizens, even those in urban areas far from where the environmental crimes occur. To tell the stories that the data was revealing, we assembled a team of local reporters, distributed throughout the most impacted states according to our analysis. Five reports were published and gained nationwide attention, driven also by a publishing partnership with the largest national daily newspaper in Brazil and with the two institutions that were partners in the analyses, the Ufac and the Oswaldo Cruz Foundation (Fiocruz), the federal institution of science and technology. The articles were republished in local newspapers and by research institutes that had been a reference for our project. We have participated in several meetings and interviews to talk about the results, an academic article with Fiocruz is being written based on our data, and a technical note from the Acre Public Ministry also refers to our data to stress the importance of monitoring air quality.
2022-s-0498.tools: QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, R Studio, MapBox
2022-s-0498.authors: Juliana Mori, Renata Hirota, Eduardo Geraque, Felipe Barros, Sonaira Silva, Tatiane Moraes, Guilherme Guerreiro Neto, Juliana Arini, Leandro Chaves, Camilo Estevam, Rebeca Navarro, Lucas Lobo, Leandro Amorim, André Hanauer, Erlan De Almeida Carvalho, Erico Rosa, Guilherme Lobo, Robson Klein Ramon Aquim, Dell Pinheiro, Laiza Lopes, Laura Sanchez, Tony Gross
2022-s-0498.summaryJa: 吸煙は,この流行期間中にブラジルアマゾンの人口の健康に野生火災による空気の汚染の影響を調査する特別プロジェクトです. この毒性シナージは,ジャーナリスト,地理学者,統計学者,科学者の多学科的なチームによって実施された前例のないデータ分析の対象でした. 煙は最も影響を受けた5州で重篤なコビッド病例の18%増加と呼吸器症候群の入院の24%増加に関連した.
2022-s-0498.impactJa: このプロジェクトの関連性は,二つの明らかに分離した出来事 (火災とCOVID) の間の関係を示すため,環境と公衆衛生の問題はどのように密接に関連しているかを強調しています.データでは,アマゾン火災からの汚染が,特定の火災地理によって人口に悪影響を及ぼすことが明らかになっています. 広範なデータ分析を通じて,このプロジェクトは火による汚染がCOVID病例の悪化に及ぼす影響を量化することができ,読者が環境危機の重さを理解し,政府がデータに基づいて意思決定を行うための補助金を提供しました. 2021年にこのようなプロジェクトの重要性は大規模な死後の調査に似ています Amazonasの破壊とその市民に影響を及ぼす証拠を持ち込みます都市部でさえも環境犯罪が起こる場所から遠く離れた都市部ですデータが明らかにした物語を伝えるために私たちは地元の記者団を集めました 5つのレポートが公表され,全国的に注目され,ブラジル最大の全国日刊新聞と分析のパートナーだった2つの機関であるUfacと連邦科学技術機関であるオスワルド・クルズ財団 (Fiocruz) との出版提携によりも推進されました. 成果について話すために,我々はいくつかの会議やインタビューに参加しました,Fiocruzとの学術記事が私たちのデータに基づいて書かれています,そして,アクレ公務省の技術的な注釈も私たちのデータに言及しています.

2022-s-0499.summary: Since the Age of Discovery, humans have explored the world's sea routes, but there is still one of the "Seven Seas" that has yet to be conquered: The Arctic Ocean. The Northern Sea Route is gaining prominence because of global warming, and it is the shortest route between East Asia and Europe. It has the potential to rewrite the world's logistics networks. The Arctic is also rich in natural resources, and the U.S., China and Russia have begun to compete for control of the region. It is also becoming important for Japan's energy policy.
2022-s-0499.impact: We published this project both in Japanese and English. Both received high engagement from our readers, especially from geospatial experts.
2022-s-0499.authors: Yuji Nitta, Tomoyo Ogawa, Kazuhiro Kida
2022-s-0499.summaryJa: 発見の時代以来,人類は世界の海路を探検してきたが,まだ征服されていない"7つの海"の一つは北極大洋である.北海路は,地球温暖化により知名度が高くなり,東アジアとヨーロッパ間の最短の路線である. 北極は自然資源にも富んでいるし,米国,中国,ロシアは地域の支配のために競争し始めた.
2022-s-0499.impactJa: このプロジェクトを日本語と英語で公開しました. 両者とも読者の高い関心を獲得しました. 特に地質学専門家から.

2022-s-0500.summary: The report assessed public data regarding the sale of industrialized controlled drugs and antimicrobial medications from January 2018 to March 2021 and found that Brazilian pharmacies had sold over 52 million tablets of the so-called "covid kit". Our investigation also revealed that hydroxychloroquine, a drug largely promoted by Bolsonaro, had sold more than 1.3 million boxes in Brazil. Peak sales of hydroxychloroquine and azithromycin were in March 2021, the worst month in covid-19 deaths in the country. We also found that after a statement by Bolsonaro, the government simplified rules for reusing prescriptions for the purchase of the drugs.
2022-s-0500.impact: The article showed the impacts of President Bolsonaro's promotion of the consumption of drugs with no proven efficacy against covid-19 in both speeches and actions. The report was republished by 46 national media outlets and websites and was cited or backlinked at least 22 times.
2022-s-0500.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, R Studio
2022-s-0500.summaryJa: 報告書は2018年1月から2021年3月までの工業化制御薬と抗菌薬の販売に関する公開データを評価し,ブラジルの薬局が"COVID kit"と呼ばれる5200万錠以上を販売したことを発見しました. 国内でCOVID-19死亡率で最悪の1ヶ月だった2021年3月炭酸塩とアジトロミシンのピーク売上高は12%でしたボルソナロの声明の後,政府は薬物の購入のための処方箋の再利用の規則を簡素化した.
2022-s-0500.impactJa: 報告書は46の全国メディアやウェブサイトで再刊され,少なくとも22回引用またはバックリンクされた.

2022-s-0501.summary: In the last 17 years, companies in the extractive sector that have been involved in socio-environmental conflicts in Peru have signed security/protection agreements with the National Police for more than US $18,490,566. Are these contracts legal? Police agreements with private companies are legal as an organic law states that the institution can provide "rented services of a particular nature." Yet a recent ruling recognizes that these contracts can be perceived as a loss of objectivity", and indicates that the Police should only provide security to companies that demonstrate that they cannot obtain that service from private security companies.
2022-s-0501.impact: The Minister of Interior, Avelino Guillén, acknowledged the findings of this investigation and said that he would evaluate the information with his advisory cabinet. This is the first time a journalistic investigation in Peru has looked into the relationship between large mining and oil companies and the Peruvian Police. The findings of this report have shown that the Peruvian Police might have a biased behavior during social conflicts in mining regions, instead of providing protection to local communities.
2022-s-0501.summaryJa: 過去17年間でペルーにおける社会環境紛争に関与した採掘業の企業は連邦警察と18490,566ドル以上のセキュリティ・保護契約を締結しました民間企業との警察契約は,有機法として,機関が"特定の性質のレンタサービス"を提供できるという法律である.しかし,最近の判決は,これらの契約は客観性の喪失として認識される可能性があることを認識し",警察は,民間セキュリティ企業からそのサービスを入手できないことを示す企業にのみセキュリティを提供すべきであることを示しています.
2022-s-0501.impactJa: 内務省大臣アヴェリノ・ギレンは調査の結果を認めた.彼は助言官僚の閣僚とともに情報を評価すると述べた. ペルーのジャーナリスト調査が,大型鉱山・石油会社とペルー警察との関係を調査したのは初めてである. この報告書の発見はペルー警察が地域社会に保護を提供するのではなく鉱山地域の社会紛争において偏見的な行動をとる可能性があることを示しています

2022-s-0502.summary: Our data team is all about the numbers—and we want to share that love and enthusiasm for spreadsheets with everyone. Our Off the Charts newsletter—the first data newsletter by a major newspaper—was launched in mid-February 2021 and since then our team has been sharing their behind-the-scenes processes and workflow with tens of thousands of data fans across the globe. Whether you’re fluent in R or Python, or a D3 novice or just want to learn how to elevate your data visualisations—the newsletter reaches a broad audience of data experts and those who want to become one.
2022-s-0502.impact: Every week, we receive many messages from readers who delight in The Economist’s data journalism and love learning from our team. Our aim was to give everyone the opportunity to get a unique insight into the inner workings of an international data team at a major newspaper. We want to make ourselves approachable and invite our readers to send questions, suggestions and comments to our team (offthecharts@economist.com) and share our behind the scenes in the newsletter every week. We’ve explained the processes behind our coronavirus coverage, for example, our normalcy index and excess-death tracker. We have weighed up the pros and cons of Python compared to R and explained why we rarely use polar charts, how we visualise outliers, how we deal with unreliable stats such as China’s GDP and how we gather and check the data for our infamous Big Mac index. We’ve also explained how we adapt our work for colour blindness, how log scales work and how to declutter a chart to make it easier to read. The comments and feedback we get from colleagues across the industry and other readers—often students or academics who seek to improve their data vis for their scientific papers—show that we are reaching people in and outside of our bubble and are successfully sharing our love for data and inspiring the work of others.
2022-s-0502.authors: The Economist data and newsletter teams
2022-s-0502.summaryJa: 私たちのデータチームは数字についてです.私たちはスプレッドシートへの愛と熱意をすべての人に分かち合いたいです.私たちのオフ・ザ・チャートニュースレター (Off the Charts) は,主要な新聞による最初のデータニュースレターです. 2021年2月中旬に開始されました.それ以来,私たちのチームは世界中の数千人のデータファンと幕後プロセスとワークフローを共有しています. Rや Pythonを流暢に習うか,D3の初心者でも,データビジュアライゼーションを向上させたいか,ニュースレターにはデータ専門家やその専門家になりたい人の幅広い視聴者が利用されています.
2022-s-0502.impactJa: 週ごとに,私たちはThe Economistのデータジャーナリズムに喜ぶ読者から多くのメッセージを受け取り,私たちのチームから学ぶことを愛しています.私たちの目標は,誰もが主要な新聞の国際データチームの内部機能についてユニークな洞察を得られる機会を与えることです. 私たちは,自分たちを親近なものにしたいし,読者たちに質問や提案やコメントをチーム (offthecharts@economist.com) に送信し,毎週ニュースレターで幕後での体験をシェアすることをおすすめします.私たちは,コロナウイルス感染の背後にあるプロセスを説明しました.例えば,正常性の指標や過剰死亡追跡器. Rと比較してPythonのメリット・デメリットについて検討し,なぜ極地チャートをほとんど使わないのか,外見値をどのように視覚化するか,中国のGDPなどの信頼性の低い統計とどのように対処するか,そして,臭名高いビッグマック指数に関するデータをどのように収集しチェックするかについて説明しました.また,色盲のために私たちの作業をどのように調整するか,ログスケールの働き方,読みやすくするためにチャートを解析する方法についても説明しました. 業界全体からの同僚や他の読者からのコメントやフィードバックしばしば科学論文のデータ・ビジュアルを改善しようとする学生や学者からいただくコメントやフィードバックは泡の中の外にも人を訪れ,データへの愛を共有し,他者の仕事へのインスピレーションを成功に与えることを示しています.

2022-s-0503.summary: The report analyzed data on chloroquine shipments made by the federal government and revealed that 2.8 million tablets were shipped throughout Brazil. The report showed to which states the chloroquine shipments were sent and on which dates. We also showed that military laboratories produced 25 times the amount of chloroquine that was normally produced to fight malaria.
2022-s-0503.impact: The article was the first to reveal the entire path of chloroquine distribution by the government including details of where each batch was sent. A major opposition party cited the report in a complaint to the Supreme Court about the amount of chloroquine produced by the Army and Navy laboratories in 2020. The report substantiated questions and criticism of the government's actions during a parliamentary inquiry conducted by the Brazilian Federal Senate to investigate Bolsonaro's handling of the pandemic. The article was republished by 31 websites and national media outlets and cited or backlinked in at least 22 publications, such as Reporters without Borders, El País, and O Estado de S. Paulo.
2022-s-0503.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R
2022-s-0503.authors: Anna Beatriz Anjos, Bianca Muniz, Bruno Fonseca, Larissa Fernandes
2022-s-0503.summaryJa: 報告書は連邦政府によるクロロキインの輸送に関するデータを分析しブラジル全体で2800万錠が輸送されたことを明らかにしました報告書はどの州にクロロキインの輸送が送られたかどの日付で送られたかを示しましたまた軍事研究室でマラリア対策のために通常生産されるクロロキインの25倍も生産されたことを示しました
2022-s-0503.impactJa: 重要な反対派政党は,2020年に陸軍と海軍研究室が生産したクロロキンの量について最高裁判所への投訴で報告書を引用した. 報告書は,ブラジル連邦上院がボルソナロのパンデミック対策を調査する議会調査中に政府の行動に対する疑問と批判を根拠とした. この記事は31のウェブサイトや全国メディア機関によって再刊され,少なくとも22の出版物,例えば国境なき記者,エル・パイス,サンパウロ州などで引用またはバックリンクされた.

2022-s-0504.summary: When Portugal had already reached more than half of its population completely vaccinated, the restriction in place became less rigid. But doing one of those activities that everyone missed so much now meant asking: how safe if it? Should I do it? In collaboration with a local university, PÚBLICO developed a risk assessment tool to help with that decision.
2022-s-0504.impact: The project was seen by the public as a precious tool for informed decision-making. Because it allowed people to measure on a qualitative scale how safe such activity was, it attracted a lot of traffic, since we understood that the readers were using the tool to plan their activities.
2022-s-0504.tools: Personalisation, Scraping, D3.js, Json, Google Sheets, R, R Studio, Svelte
2022-s-0504.authors: Rui Barros, Ivo Neto, Dinis Correia, Pedro M. Teixeira
2022-s-0504.summaryJa: ポルトガルの人口の半分以上が完全にワクチン接種を受けていたとき規制は厳しくなくなりましたが誰もがあまり見逃していた活動の一つをやってみるとどれぐらい安全なのか尋ねる意味がありました
2022-s-0504.impactJa: プロジェクトが知的な意思決定のための貴重なツールとして一般市民に見られました. プロジェクトが人々がその活動がいかに安全かを質量的に測定できるようにするため,多くのトラフィックを集めました読者がそのツールを使って活動を計画していることを理解したからです

2022-s-0505.summary: The field in Spain has changed and is calling into question the economic, social and environmental objectives of the European Common Agricultural Policy. Spain is the first producer and exporter of olive oil in the world. We discover the damage that, after three decades since it was discovered, has already occurred in a mass of groundwater that saved one of the largest olive-growing regions. We reveal that the large pork companies, despite billing hundreds of millions and having high returns, receving million-dollar subsidies. We visualize for the first time on maps the impact on greenhouse gas emissions of pig macro-farms.
2022-s-0505.impact: The report was published in DATADISTA and simultaneously, thanks to a broadcast agreement, in Eldiario.es. This journalistic investigation had a diffusion in single visitors of more than 200,000 visits and has been cited in different national, regional and specialized media as one of the most in-depth investigations on agriculture and intensive livestock farming in Spain. It has also been widely disseminated on social networks (such as Twitter) where we have created different threads for dissemination with thousands of hits. As a result of an interview in The Guardian with the Spanish Minister of Consumer Affairs at the beginning of 2022 where he criticized the Spanish model of macro-farms, our work has once again become viral, since different political parties and associations have spread hoaxes and disinformation about the reality of the agriculture and intensive farming in Spain.
2022-s-0505.tools: Animation, Drone, Scraping, D3.js, QGIS, JQuery, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, CSV, Python, Open Refine
2022-s-0505.summaryJa: スペインの分野は変わりつつあり,欧州共同農業政策の経済・社会・環境目標に疑問を投げかけています.スペインは世界で最初のオリーブ油生産国であり,輸出国でもあります. 豚肉の大企業は億万ドルの補助金を受けながらも高い収益を得ていることを明らかにしました豚マクロ農場による温室効果ガスの排出への影響を初めて地図に映し出しました
2022-s-0505.impactJa: 報道は, DATADISTAで同時に, 放送協定のおかげで, Eldiario.esで公開されました. このジャーナリズムの調査は,単一の訪問者数で200,000件以上で拡散し,スペインの農業と密集型家畜飼育に関する最も深い調査の一つとして,様々な全国,地域,専門メディアで引用されています. ソーシャルメディア (Twitterなど) でも広まっています広まることのための異なるスレッドを何千というヒットで作成しました 2022年初旬にスペイン消費者大臣がマクロ農場のスペインモデルを批判した"ガーディアン"誌のインタビューの結果,私たちの仕事は再びウイルスに転じました.

2022-s-0506.summary: The Covid-19 pandemic tossed 2020 into disarray. But while cities and countries around the globe were shutting down, scientists and researchers from nearly every country embarked on an unprecedented effort to study, understand, and contain a virus that no one had ever seen before. By exploring the 90,000+ Covid-related research articles that emerged in 2020, this project celebrated the achievements and effort of the global science and research community, while also providing the public a behind-the-scenes glimpse of the scientific process more generally, and an appreciation for the resources that it requires.
2022-s-0506.impact: The goal of the project was two-fold: 1) to call attention to the scale and enormity of the collaborative, worldwide research effort to combat the Covid-19 pandemic; and 2) , to emphasize to the public the normal workings of the scientific process and, impart an appreciation for the work that is required and the inevitable uncertainty that ensues along the way. Unlike a project advocating for a particular policy change, for example, it is hard to know whether a project like this has achieved its intended impact or not, particularly with regard to the second goal of promoting greater public awareness of the scientific process. However, the extent to which this story was picked up and highlighted by science, research, and journalism outlets perhaps offers some indication of its wider impact. Throughout 2020, this project was featured by, among others, The World Federation of Science Journalists, The University of Wisconsin's Scout Report on STEM and humanities, DataJournalism.com's year-end "12 brilliant data journalism projects of 2021", and was selected for presentation during the Science Communication panel at the 2021 Information+ Conference.
2022-s-0506.tools: Animation, Scraping, D3.js, Three.js, CSV, Python
2022-s-0506.summaryJa: コビッド-19 流行が2020年を混乱に陥った.しかし,世界中の都市や国が閉鎖している間に,ほぼすべての国の科学者や研究者は,これまでに誰も見たことのないウイルスを研究し,理解し,抑えるために前例のない努力を始めました. 2020年に発生した90,000以上のコビッド関連研究記事を調査することで,このプロジェクトは,世界的な科学と研究コミュニティの業績と努力を祝い,また一般科学プロセスについて幕後での見出しと,その需要のある資源の評価を公開しました.
2022-s-0506.impactJa: プロジェクトの目的は2つ目:COVID-19の流行を撲滅するためのコラボレーション的な世界的な研究活動の規模と巨大さに注意を喚起し,そして2) 科学プロセスが正常な仕組みを公に強調し,必要な作業と途中で必然的な不確実性を認識する. 例えば,特定の政策変更を主張するプロジェクトとは異なり,このようなプロジェクトが意図された影響を達成したか否かは,特に科学プロセスに対する公衆の意識を高める第二の目標に関して,知ることは難しい.しかし,この物語が科学,研究,ジャーナリズムメディアによって取り上げられ,強調された程度は,おそらくより広範な影響を示す証拠を提示している. 2020年を通して,このプロジェクトは,他のものなど,世界科学ジャーナリスト連盟,ウィスコンシン大学STEMと人文学のスカウトレポート, DataJournalism.comの年末年始"2021年の12の素晴らしいデータジャーナリズムプロジェクト"によって紹介され,2021年情報+会議の科学コミュニケーションパネル中に発表のために選出された.

2022-s-0507.summary: Our on-going redistricting interactive follows the drawing of district lines that will help shape who holds political power in the U.S. for the next 10 years. The project tracks proposed congressional maps — and whether they might benefit Democrats or Republicans in the 2022 midterms and beyond.
2022-s-0507.impact: This project pulls back the curtain on the decennial redistricting process – a process that affects how much of a voice every voter in the U.S. has in our political discourse yet is so sprawling and complex that it verges on opaqueness. By measuring the fairness and competitiveness of every proposed map in every state, as well as how each would change the racial and ethnic makeup of districts, it gives voters a clear, simplified view of how the playing field of U.S. politics is being tilted by the parties. This project has already received more than 25 million page views – evidence that people are using it to track and understand this crucial part of America’s political system. Moreover, we’ve seen many state and local reporters use the data and maps generated in this project in their own coverage of redistricting.
2022-s-0507.authors: Nathaniel Rakich, Sarah Frostenson, Ryan Best, Aaron Bycoffe,, Julia Wolfe, Santul Nerkar, Emily Scherer
2022-s-0507.summaryJa: 州議会の地図は,今後10年間,米国における政治権力の保持者を形作る役所線を描き出す. プロジェクトでは,議会の提案された地図を追跡し, 2022年中期以降に民主党や共和党に利益をもたらすかどうか追跡する.
2022-s-0507.impactJa: このプロジェクトは10年にわたる再区分プロセスについて幕を引く.このプロセスは,米国の各選挙人が政治演説にどれだけ大きな声を持っているかに影響する.しかし,それは不透明性に迫るほど広範囲で複雑です.各州における提案された地図の公平性と競争力を測定し,各州がどの程度人種的および民族的構成を変化させるかを測定することで,選挙人は米国の競技場の仕組みについて明確な,簡素化された見方をすることができます. 政策は政党によって傾いている.このプロジェクトは既に2500万ページビュー以上を記録している. 証拠は,人々がそれを利用してアメリカの政治システムの重要な部分を追跡し理解していることを示している. さらに,多くの州や地方の記者がこのプロジェクトで生成されたデータと地図を,再区分に関する自身の報道に利用している.

2022-s-0508.summary: EdWeek Market Brief is a business publication that covers the education market and the universe of companies doing business in schools. In December of 2021, we published a special report titled "What's the Role of Education Companies in Supporting Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion?" The report seeks to help education companies in the U.S. and internationally understand what school districts need from them in promoting racial/ethnic inclusivity efforts -- a huge area of interest within school communities.
2022-s-0508.impact: This project offers a first-of-its kind, research-based roadmap for private companies operating in the multi-billion dollar education marketplace to change their products and behavior so that they better reflect the racially and ethnically diverse student populations and school communities they serve. Over the past year and a half, many of the United States' school districts have rethought their policies and practices on race and equity, in an effort to respond to the demands from parents and communities. Much has been written about these efforts. In this special report, EdWeek Market Brief broke new ground by looking at diversity, equity, and inclusion from a completely different perspective: We examined the critical role that education companies need to play in helping school systems make progress on DEI. The report is based on a nationally representative survey by EdWeek Market Brief of K-12 officials, who were asked about the kinds of specific products and features – and leadership – they expect from businesses delivering curriculum, assessment, professional development, and other essential products. The special report combines deep reporting with original research to provide education businesses with a guide for making the kinds of changes to their products and practices that are often talked about, but rarely brought to the finish line. The report was delivered to EdWeek Market Brief's base of subscribers -- who include some of the biggest education-focused businesses in the world, as well as startups, research institutions and others. It has the potential to shape the work of education companies in the market on DEI for years to come.
2022-s-0508.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Survey Building and Delivery Tools
2022-s-0508.authors: Maurice Bakley, Sean Cavanagh, David Saleh Rauf, Emma Kate Fittes, Holly Kurtz, Sterling Lloyd, Alex Harwin, Laura Baker, Liz Yap.
2022-s-0508.summaryJa: EdWeek Market Brief は,教育市場と学校でビジネスをする企業の宇宙をカバーするビジネス出版物です.2021年12月に"多様性,公平性,包摂を支援する教育企業の役割は何ですか?"という特別レポートを公開しました.このレポートは米国における教育企業を支援することを目指しています. 民族的包摂の取り組みを推進するために学校の区画が必要なことを国際的に理解し学校のコミュニティーに関心のある大きな分野です
2022-s-0508.impactJa: このプロジェクトは数十億ドル規模の教育市場で活動する民間企業に独自の開発計画を提供し製品や行動を変えることで学生や学校が奉仕する民族や人種多様性のある学生群と学校コミュニティをよりよく反映しています過去一年半,米国の多くの学校区は,親やコミュニティの要求に応えるために,人種平等に関する政策や慣行を改めて考えています.この努力について多くの書籍が書かれています. この特別報告では,EdWeek Market Briefは,多様性,公平性,包摂を全く別の視点から見て新たな道を切り開きました. 教育企業が DEIの進捗を支援する上で果たすべき重要な役割を検討しました. このレポートは,K-12の職員に対して EdWeek Market Briefが実施した全国代表的な調査に基づいています. 彼らはカリキュラム,評価,専門開発,その他の重要な製品を提供する企業から期待する特定の製品や機能やリーダーシップについて尋ねられました. この特別レポートは,教育企業にしばしば話題にされる,しかし,ほとんど完成しない製品や実践に変化をもたらすためのガイドを提供するために, 詳細なレポートとオリジナルの研究を組み合わせています. このレポートはEdWeek Market Briefのサブスクリプションベースに届けられました. 未来年にわたって DEI市場における教育企業の活動を形作る可能性もあります

2022-s-0509.summary: For eight years, the Tampa Police Department used the threat of eviction as a tactic to reduce crime in some of the city’s poorest neighborhoods, urging landlords to evict tenants based solely on arrests. Officers gave landlords legal cover to evict anyone found to be involved in criminal activity, then sent landlords arrest notices and called on them to take action. The program went under the radar until a Tampa Bay Times investigation showed that entire families were evicted based on the arrest of a single member and that 90 percent of those reported to their landlords were Black.
2022-s-0509.impact: When the Times first contacted the Tampa Police Department regarding the program in 2017, they immediately changed some aspects of the program. The department removed wording from the notifications of arrests that stated that landlords were “required to take immediate actions through notice to cure, notice to vacate, or eviction.”. The department also sent out fewer letters in years following that first contact. Civil rights groups — including the NAACP and ACLU — sent a letter calling for the city to “immediately end” the Crime-Free Multi Housing Program. The letter, sent two days after our first story published, cited our reporting and noted that “the Program compounds the over-policing of people of color in Tampa and causes catastrophic consequences for people of color.” On the same day, local state and city representatives called on the mayor to suspend the program for re-evaluation. The next day Tampa mayor Jane Castor announced reforms to the program, adding police oversight and restricting the type and location of arrests that would be reported to landlords. In December 2021, the city scrapped the program and announced that it would no longer send reports to landlords detailing the arrests of their tenants. Within a month after our story first published, the Orlando Police Department and Orange County Sheriff’s Office announced that they planned to end their own programs similar to the Crime-Free Multi Housing Program.
2022-s-0509.tools: Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, R Studio, OpenStreetMap, OpenRefine, Tabula
2022-s-0509.authors: Ian Hodgson, Christopher O'Donnell, Nathaniel Lash
2022-s-0509.summaryJa: タンパ警察局は8年間,町で最も貧しい地域の一部で犯罪を減らすための戦術として排放の脅威を使用し,所有者に逮捕のみに基づいて賃貸者を排放するよう促した.警察官は,犯罪活動に関与していることが判明した所有者に合法的な保護を与え,その後,所有者に逮捕通知を送り,行動を促した. プログラムが監視されずタンパ・ベイ・タイムズの調査によると一人のメンバーが逮捕されたことで家族全体が避難しその90パーセントが黒人だと報告されたのです
2022-s-0509.impactJa: タイムズは2017年にプログラムに関するタンパ警察署に連絡した際,すぐにプログラムのいくつかの側面を変更した.部門は,最初に連絡された後,部下がすぐに治療,避難通知,または避難を通知することによって直ちに行動する必要があると宣言した逮捕通知から文を削除した. 市民権団体 NAACPとACLUを含む団体が都市に犯罪のない多重住宅プログラムを直ちに終了するよう要請する手紙を送った. 初の記事発表から2日後送られた手紙は,我々の報告を引用し, プログラムがタンパの色人種に対する過剰な警察を加害し,色人種の人々にとって悲惨な結果をもたらすと指摘した. 翌日,タンパ市長ジェーン・カスターは,警察の監督を加え,土地所有者に報告される逮捕の種類と場所を制限し,プログラム改革を発表しました.2021年12月に市はプログラムを廃止し,賃貸者の逮捕を詳細に記載する報告を土地所有者に送らないことを発表した. 記事が最初に公開された1ヶ月以内にオランダ警察局とオレンジ郡警官事務所は犯罪のない多重住宅計画に似た独自のプログラムを終了する予定だと発表した.

2022-s-0510.summary: Maldita.es compiled in a systematic way the cases of politicians and public representatives who jumped the vaccination line in Spain. The analysis of the data made possible to see in which areas of the country the vaccination protocol was being breached the most or which political parties were taking the most doses unnecessarily. Maldita.es was the first media to provide this information, and then others began to do same. It's the only media that has continued to review, update and to monitor what has become of those politicians who jumped the line a year after vaccination began.
2022-s-0510.impact: The impact of the first report in which Maldita.es compiled all the cases from its own database of politicians who skipped the vaccination queue had a brutal impact in Spain. Many media started to cover the data we collected about these cases and many others created similar pieces, although most of them were gradually abandoned. In addition, many politicians took up Maldita.es's maps and graphics in person to denounce opponents who were skipping the vaccination queue. There were spokespersons of political parties in Spain who showed the Maldita.es map of vaccinated politicians printed in large size in the Congress and in electoral debates on prime time television. A large number of politicians from different parties (especially the parties with the fewest cases) have also shared this information on social networks and on their websites. This information has undoubtedly been one of Maldita.es's most impactful in 2021. We then looked at what had become of the politicians who jumped the vaccination line in a new report in December: just one year after the start of vaccination. The impact was also very big. No other media was tracking and reviewing what had become of them in order to be able to audit their work and be able to tell the public about. We were also able to reveal in December after obtaining via FOIA the vaccination data from the Health Department of the Region of Murcia (one of the states in Spain) and analysing it that 75% of its non-health care workers were vaccinated before their turn. Almost 400 workers. Vaccination in Murcia was a scandal because different politicians jumped the line. We were able to reveal and certify with data that not only high-ranking officials such as the regional minister had been vaccinated.
2022-s-0510.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2022-s-0510.authors: Sergio Sangiao, Adela Vived, Rubén Díaz, Nacho Calle y José Molina.
2022-s-0510.summaryJa: Maldita.esは,スペインでワクチン接種線を突破した政治家や公務員に関する事例を体系的にまとめましたデータ分析により,国のどの地域でワクチン接種プロトコルが最も違反されているか,どの政党が最も多量の薬を不必要な方法で服用しているかを確認することが可能になりました. Maldita.esは,この情報を最初に提供したメディアであり,その後,他のメディアも同様のことをし始めました. ワクチン接種開始から1年後にラインを突っ込んだ政治家たちの状況をレビューし更新し監視し続けました
2022-s-0510.impactJa: Maldita.esがワクチン接種隊をスキップした政治家たちのデータベースからすべての症例をまとめましたこのレポートの影響はスペインで残酷な影響を与えた. 多くのメディアはこれらの症例に関する収集したデータをカバーし,他の多くのメディアが同様の作品を作成したが,その多くは徐々に放棄された. 選挙の討論で,プレймタイムテレビで大規模な印刷されたマップを展示したスペインの政治政党のスポークスマンがいました. 異なる政党 (特に少数ケースを持つ政党) の多くの政治家も,この情報をソーシャルメディアやウェブサイトで共有しています. この情報は 2021年に間違いなくマルドイタ.エスの最も影響力を及ぼした情報の一つです. ワクチン接種開始からわずか"年後の12月に発表された新しい報告書でワクチン接種の直線を突破した政治家たちの身につけた結果を見てきました影響も非常に大きいのです他のメディアは彼らの仕事を監査し公開できるように彼らの身につけた結果を追跡しレビューしませんでした医療従事者の75%が轮回前に接種されたことを分析しおよそ400人の労働者が接種したことが明らかになりましたワクチン接種はスキャンダルでした異なる政治家たちがラインを飛び越えたからです地域大臣のような高官だけがワクチン接種を受けたことを明らかにしデータを証明することができました

2022-s-0511.summary: For the first time, the Portuguese Education Ministry gave access to an anonymized database with the grades of the students from 11.º e 12.º years in public schools. The database contained information such as if a student had “escalão A” - a subsidy given to poorer students. The data allowed us to conclude that poorer students have lower marks in every subject, but also that they tend to choose Humanities rather than STEM.
2022-s-0511.impact: The story allowed everyone to understand how the Portuguese public school is not yet able to end with the differences between students from poorer and richer families. Even though the national exam's data already allowed us to check that students from poorer backgrounds tend to have lower marks on those exams, the data on this database was way more comprehensive. Apart from the already mentioned trend observed that students from poorer families tend to avoid STEM, we were already able to observe a bigger gap in subjects like Geometry and English rather than, for example, Sociology. Those trends need a more comprehensive database (including several school years, something that was not provided by the Portuguese authorities), but might give public authorities some clues about what could be done to close the gap between poorer and richer students.
2022-s-0511.tools: Microsoft Excel, R, R Studio, flourish
2022-s-0511.summaryJa: ポルトガル教育省は初めて公立学校で11年生と12年生の生徒の成績を匿名化されたデータベースにアクセスしました.データベースには,学生が A<unk> (貧乏な生徒に与えられる補助金) を有った場合のような情報が含まれていました.データによって,貧乏な生徒がすべての科目で低い成績を持っていると結論付けることができました. しかし,彼らはSTEMよりも人文科を選択する傾向があります.
2022-s-0511.impactJa: この物語は,ポルトガル公立学校が貧しい家庭から来た学生と裕福な家庭からの学生との違いをまだ理解できていないことをすべて理解させました. 国民試験のデータは既に,貧しい背景からの生徒がこれらの試験で成績が低いことを確認することを許しましたが,このデータベースのデータははるかに包括的なものでした. 貧しい家庭の学生が STEMを避けることが明らかになった傾向を除いてジオメトリや英語のような科目では社会学よりも大きなギャップが見られましたこれらの傾向はより包括的なデータベースを必要とします (いくつかの学年を含む,ポルトガル当局が提供していないものですが), しかし,より貧しい学生とより裕福な学生とのギャップを閉じるために何ができるのかに関するいくつかの手がかりを公共当局に与えることができます.

2022-s-0512.summary: The Maldito Dato twitcherías have been broadcasts that have taken place throughout 2021 on the Maldita.es Twitch channel. In these broadcasts, information of public interest has been told to a new audience thanks to data journalism. These broadcasts carried out by the section specialising in data journalism have taken place once every two weeks throughout the whole of 2021.
2022-s-0512.impact: First Twitch broadcasts in Spain based on data journalism. Reaching a younger public and new audiences. Construction of stories based on data journalism to give them full format on Twitch, as in the case of the Olympic Games programme or the 25-N elections. But we also invite other media that are doing things related to the theme of the broadcast. The intention is to divulge the best journalism and the best data journalism, even if it is done by others. We tell our own stories and those of others, and we invite them too to give them this platform. Spain's leading data units and data journalists are invited. Also journalists and experts in other fields that can enrich on a specific topic.
2022-s-0512.tools: Scraping, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, OpenStreetMap, Python, A lot of different technologies because for each broadcast we do different things and previous analysis.

2022-s-0513.summary: A year after a massive shipment of ammonium nitrate exploded in Beirut, an OCCRP investigation has settled one of the biggest lingering questions: who actually owned the cargo. These findings paint the fullest picture yet of the people & entities behind the ammonium nitrate that exploded on August 4, 2020, inflicting up to $8.2 billion of material & economic damage & helping to tip a country already struggling due to corruption & mismanagement into an outright crisis. A trail of documents reveals a decades-old chemical-trading network controlled by Ukrainians, hidden behind a veil of proxies and shell firms.
2022-s-0513.impact: The investigation was well-received. Aljazeera English interviewed the OCCRP lead project editor. Jadeed TV in Lebanon interviewed the reporter & the senior MENA editor. OCCRP’s local media partner, Daraj,com, reported 20,000+ read the investigation. Several TV stations debated the findings & organized political talk shows. Two local media groups contacted OCCRP for help in setting up investigative units that publish stories of interest to the public & that holds power to account. Lebanese lawyers, led by Camille Abousleiman, are suing Savaro in the U.K. on behalf of the blast victims — 218 dead, 7,000 injured, 300,000+ homeless — arguing that the company bears significant responsibility. Abousleiman told Jadeed TV that the OCCRP investigation “and the data vis-à-vis the owner of the cargo is true. The owner of the company is Verbonol. We are trying to integrate the OCCRP investigation into our case.” The Ukrainian company has denied any involvement & laid the blame on Lebanese authorities. The results & the proceedings at the UK court will put direct pressure on Lebanon’s highly-politicized legal system to expose & try the culprits. Many believe the political elite bear responsibility after evidence emerged that senior officials were aware of the risks posed by the ammonium nitrate, but did nothing. Only low & mid-ranking port & customs officials have been charged. A local judge tried to charge senior officials w/negligence, including then prime minister Hassan Diab, but the judge was removed after pushback from the country’s political establishment. A new judge was appointed & is continuing inquiries.

2022-s-0513.summaryJa: 石油が爆発した1年後に,OCCRPの調査は,最大の問題の一つを解決しました. 貨物を所有したのは誰なのか. これらの発見は, 2020年8月4日に爆発した石油が爆発した人々の全貌を描く. 物質と経済に820億ドルもの損害をもたらし,腐敗と管理不良によって苦しんでいる国を危機に陥らせる. 文書の痕跡はウクライナ人によって制御されている何十年もの化学取引ネットワークを明らかにし代理商やシェル企業の隠れ穴に隠されています
2022-s-0513.impactJa: 捜査は好評でした.アルジャジーラ・イングリッシュはOCCRPのリードプロジェクト編集者をインタビューした.Jadeed TV in Lebanonは記者とMENAのシニア編集者をインタビューした.OCCRPの地元のメディアパートナー,Daraj,comは,調査を20,000+人が読み上げた. 2つの地元のメディアグループがOCCRPに連絡して,公益の物語を公開する調査ユニットを設置する助けを求めた. レバノン弁護士は,Camille Abousleimanが率いる. 株式会社バーボノール (Verbonol) の所有者.我々はOCCRPの調査を我々の事件に統合しようとしています. ウクライナの会社は,いかなる関与も否定し,レバノン当局に責めをかけています. UK裁判所での結果&手続きは,レバノン<unk>の高度に政治化された法律システムに直接圧力を与えるでしょう. 多くの方が,政治エリートが責任を負うと信じているが,高官はアモニウムナイトレートによるリスクを知っていたが,何もしなかったという証拠が浮上した.ただし,低&中級の港湾&関税官員だけが起訴された.地元の裁判官は,当時の首相ハッサン・ディアブを含む高官を無謀で起訴しようとしたが,その裁判官は国の政治体制から押し戻された後,削除された.新しい裁判官が任命され,調査が継続されている.

2022-s-0514.summary: During 2021, Maldita.es investigated calls to the 016 number, the hotline for victims of gender-based violence in Spain. Thanks to the analysis of open data we were able to see that after the premiere of a documentary on television there had been the largest month-on-month increase in history. After that, via FOIA, we obtained more detailed data and thanks to this we were able to go further and count, among other things, how November 25 is the day that this number is historically called the most.
2022-s-0514.impact: The impact of the reports on the effect of Rocío Carrasco's documentary was very great. The documentary program itself and its television network (Telecinco, one of the most watched in Spain) echoed the data investigation carried out by Maldita.es. In addition, many other media echoed and we were really able to show this effect for the first time with data that was not known. The same about the calls on 25-N: until what we get the data and analyze and investigate it was unknown that it is the day that more Spanish women seek help for being victims of gender violence.
2022-s-0514.authors: Adela Vived, Sergio Sangiao, Yuly Jara, Nacho Calle and José Molina
2022-s-0514.summaryJa: 2021年中に,Maldita.es はスペインにおけるジェンダーに基づく暴力被害者のホットラインである016号への電話を調査しましたオープンデータ分析のおかげで,テレビでドキュメンタリー映画が公開された後,史上最大の月間増加が見られたことがわかりました FOIAを通じてより詳細なデータを入手しこれのおかげでより詳細に進め数えることができましたその中で 11月25日は歴史的に最も多い日です
2022-s-0514.impactJa: ロッコ・カラスコのドキュメンタリー作品の効果に関する報告の影響は非常に大きい.ドキュメンタリー番組その自身とテレビネットワーク (スペインで最も視聴されているテレビネットワークの一つであるテリシンコ) は,マルディタ.エスによって実施されたデータ調査を反響した. 25Nの電話についても同じですデータを得て分析し調査するまでは女性の性別暴力被害者の助けを求める日が明らかにならなかったのです

2022-s-0515.summary: Diesel and gasoline reach the highest prices in recent years. But how much did that impact you? And where can you find the cheapest fuel around you? At Público, we developed a news application that allowed our readers to understand exactly how much they have been impacted by the fuel crisis.
2022-s-0515.impact: The news application provided a personalized story about how much the fuel crisis was costing the reader, but also gave it some tips about where fuel was cheaper. We believe that the personalization it allowed was the key to its success, becoming a piece that keeps getting new visitors every day - making us believe that some people even bookmarked the page and use it regularly.
2022-s-0515.tools: Scraping, D3.js, Json, R, R Studio, svelte
2022-s-0515.summaryJa: ディーゼルとガソリンが最近最高価格に達しましたしかし,それがどれだけ影響を与えたのでしょうか? そして,どこで最も安い燃料を手に入れるのか? Publicoでは,読者が燃料危機の影響を受けた程度を正確に理解できるようにしたニュースアプリケーションを開発しました.
2022-s-0515.impactJa: ニュースアプリは読者に燃料危機がどれだけかかっているのかについての個人的な記事を提供しましたが燃料が安くなる場所についてのアドバイスも提供しましたパーソナライゼーションが成功の鍵だと考えましたパーソナライゼーションは毎日新しい訪問者を集めておりページを定期的に利用する人もいます

2022-s-0516.summary: Maldita.es revealed in this investigation, after a multitude of requests and claims via FOIA, a multitude of stories about hospitals in the pandemic in Spain that were not known. Its true occupation, capacity, expansion, etc. Data that was not known until the publication of the investigation and that has not been known since. Thanks to this, it was possible to know which hospitals were more saturated or which governments promised to expand hospitals that were not really expanded later, for example.
2022-s-0516.impact: The impact of the research in Spain was great. It is an investigation that continues to be read because it is the only time during the pandemic that occupancy, capacity and other data have been published in Spain hospital by hospital. Many other media echoed the investigation. And many researchers and academics are using the data that Maldita.es released for new research on the pandemic.
2022-s-0516.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, R, Python
2022-s-0516.authors: José Molina, Sergio Sangiao and Nacho Calle.
2022-s-0516.summaryJa: Maldita.es は FOIA による多くの要求や請求の後,この調査で,スペインにおけるパンデミックにおける病院についての多くの物語が明らかになりました. その真の職業,能力,拡大,など. 調査の発表まで知られていなかったデータです. どれが飽和性のある病院かどれが後ほど拡大されていない病院を拡大すると約束した政府か調べることができました
2022-s-0516.impactJa: 広報機関が調査を反発し,多くの研究者や学者がマルドイタが新型研究のために公開したデータを利用しています. 広報機関が調査を反発し,多くの研究者が研究を反発し,多くの研究者が研究している.

2022-s-0517.summary: CommonWealth's investigation on the deadest Taiwan train crash shows the serious bureaucratic flaws behind the tragedy. Based on the information we've collected, and interviews with the survivors and victims' families, we use 3D models and videos to rebuild the scene how the train crash happened, which reveals this crash didn’t have to happen.
2022-s-0517.impact: The total traffic of these series reports hits a one-day new records. We also have attention from the government, push them to reform the Taiwan Railway Administration.
2022-s-0517.authors: Silva Shih, Daniel Kao, Ying-Yu Chen, Sylvia Lee, Andy Yang, Chien-Tong Wang.
2022-s-0517.summaryJa: 事故の背後にある重大な官僚的欠陥を明らかにする.我々が収集した情報や,そして生存者と犠牲者の家族とのインタビューに基づいて,我々は3Dモデルとビデオを使用して,この事故が起こった場面を再構築しています.
2022-s-0517.impactJa: 台湾鉄道局の総流量記録は1日新記録に達しました.

2022-s-0518.summary: Focussing on the 2019-2020 anti-extradition law protests in Hong Kong, this is the first media investigation in Malaysia to map how foreign online disinformation campaigns made its way to Malaysian shores and spread within local online communities. In this eight-month-long investigation, we were able to identify disinformation surrounding the protests that have reached Malaysian audiences. We traced the origins of false information on the protests, followed their distribution paths and uncovered the main players that ‘imported’ them into Malaysian cyberspace. China’s state media, local Chinese-language media, local community-based Facebook pages and the Chinese embassy in Malaysia were among the distributors.
2022-s-0518.impact: As Southeast Asia becomes a hotbed of strategic rivalry between China and the United States, pro- and anti-Beijing propaganda targeting Chinese diaspora in Malaysia has intensified over the last few years causing worsening polarization among Malaysians especially Chinese-speaking communities. It is a well known phenomena in Malaysia but nobody has attempted to quantify and analyze it. This investigation is a local showcase of how investigation of mis- and disinformation can be done. In this country where Beijing exerts enormous influence both financially and politically, most politicians, media outlets, think tanks and academics avoid making public censure or criticism against China or Chinese Communist Party (CCP). However, the investigation, published in both English and Chinese, received 3,128 interactions on Facebook including 941 shares according to data from Crowdtangle, a rare achievement for a long-form and heavy story critical of CCP and its affiliates. After it was published, the project lead (Kuek Ser Kuang Keng) was invited to present the investigation findings at various journalism conferences including the Trusted Media Summit 2021 (recording https://vimeo.com/641757048) by Google News Initiatives (sharing the same panel with ProPublica, AFP, Digital Forensic Research Lab, EU Disinfo Lab and Australian Strategic Policy Institute), APAC Information Operation Roundtable by DoubleThink Lab, and an upcoming forum on disinformation by Asia Fact-checkers’ Network.
2022-s-0518.tools: JQuery, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2022-s-0518.authors: Kuek Ser Kuang Keng, Ng Xiang Yi, Zikri Kamarulzaman, Ramieza Wahid, Darshini Kandasamy, Hazman Hazwan, Foong Chee Wai
2022-s-0518.summaryJa: 2019-2020年の香港の反引法抗議を中心に,これはマレーシアで初めて外国オンラインデス情報キャンペーンのマッピングがマレーシアの海岸にどのように広がり,地元のオンラインコミュニティ内で広がったかを調査したメディア調査です.この8ヶ月間の調査では,マレーシアのオーディエンスに達した抗議活動を取り巻くデス情報を特定することができました. 抗議の誤った情報源を追跡し,その配送経路を追跡し,それをマレーシアのサイバー空間に輸入した主なプレイヤーを発見しました. 中国<unk>の州メディア,中国語メディア,地域コミュニティベースのFacebookページ,マレーシアの中国大使館は配送者のうちでした.
2022-s-0518.impactJa: 東南アジアが中国と米国間の戦略的ライバル性の火場となるため,マレーシアにおける中国人系を標的としたプロ・アンド・反北京のプロパガンダは,ここ数年で激化し,マレーシア人の特に中国語圏のコミュニティの間で偏差が悪化させています. この調査は,誤り・誤報の調査がどのように行われることができるかについての地元の展示です.北京が経済的にも政治的にも大きな影響力を持つこの国で,ほとんどの政治家,メディア,シンクタンク,学者は中国や中国共産党に対して公的な検閲や批判を避ける. しかし,英語と中国語で公開された調査は,CCPとそのアフィリエイトを批判する長編で重大な物語の稀な成果である Crowdtangleからのデータによると,Facebookで941件のシェアを含む 3,128件のインタラクションを受け取った. 公開後,プロジェクトリーダーは (Kuek Ser Kuang Keng) が,Googleニュースイニシアティブ (ProPublica, AFP, Digital Forensic Research Lab,EU Disinfo Lab, Australian Strategic Policy Institute, APAC Information Operation Roundtable by DoubleThink Lab, and an upcoming forum on disinfo) が,TESTED Media Summit 2021 (http://vimeo.com/641757048) を含む様々なジャーナリズム会議で調査結果を提示するよう招待されました. メディアは,中国語を翻訳する.

2022-s-0519.summary: This story measures the level of racial segregation in Philadelphia over time, and compares it to other cities. We found that Philly remains one of the most segregated cities and metros in the nation, and that the rate of desegregation has been slowing. We used data from the 6 most recent Censuses to derive the "dissimilarity index" (a common segregation measure) for Philadelphia and peer cities over time. With static and dynamic visualizations, we illustrated the racial distribution of Philadelphia's residents, how Philly's score compares, and the intuition behind how the dissimilarity index works.
2022-s-0519.impact: Our article galvanized a conversation around this ever-present but seemingly eternal issue. We saw widespread attention from policymakers, elected officials (including two US congress members), academics, and citizens around our area. Our internal analytics showed that ordinary readers were also highly engaged with this project, and that it generated a disproportionate number of letters and new subscribers.
2022-s-0519.tools: D3.js, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2022-s-0519.authors: Aseem Shukla, Michaelle Bond, Sam Morris, John Duchneskie, Dominique DeMoe, Jonathan Lai, Cindy Henry, Dan Hirschhorn
2022-s-0519.summaryJa: この記事は,フィラデルフィアにおける人種差別を時間とともに測定し,他の都市と比較した.私たちはフィラデルフィアが国内で最も分離された都市と都市の一つであり,脱离率は遅くなっていることがわかりました.我々は,過去6回の全民普查からデータを利用して,フィラデルフィアと同類都市に対する"差異指標" (共通の分離指標) を抽出しました. スタティックとダイナミックな視覚化でフィラデルフィア住民の人種分布やフィラデルフィア州のスコアがどう比較されるか違い指標の仕組みの直感を描きました
2022-s-0519.impactJa: この記事では,常に存在しているが,そう思える限り永遠の問題に関する議論が起こりました.政策立案者,選挙人 (米国議会議員2人を含む) や学術学者,市民の広範囲の注意を集めた.我々の内部分析は,普通読者がこのプロジェクトに非常に関わっており,不均衡な数の手紙と新しいサブスクリプションを生成したことを示しました.

2022-f-0001.summary: In all the projects I am presenting I have been in charge of the data analysis and the data visualisations, as well as co-structuring the stories to better present them for our audience. I have adapted my skills and my knowledge to the process and necessities of each story, using several data tools, such as R, Python, Excel, Open Refine, QGIS and Google Sheets to gather, clean and analyse data, and building visualisations with Flourish and Datawrapper to tell visual stories. I have worked on daily stories as well as medium- and long-term projects and investigations, which means that I have had to manage my time efficiently to meet all necessities. The pressure on daily and weekly stories - such as COVID analyses about infections and excess deaths within the UK and Europe or analyses to reveal the inequality in the rollout of the vaccine across the world and the importance of India in the vaccine supply - has been considerably high. I have undertaken high-level analyses, co-produced the stories and built visualisations in a short period of time - sometimes within a day. In addition to that time pressure, working for an international media means meeting high expectations, reaching a diverse audience and competing with bigger data teams. While working on longer projects and investigations, I have developed strong collaboration skills and created a robust working relationship with many departments across Sky News. The story about the people displaced due to climate events involved collaborating with designers and reporters, as well as external organisations (the Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre), and I joined forces with the recently created forensic team to reveal deforestation in the highest protected areas of the Brazilian Amazon. One of the biggest challenges during the first two years was facing the pandemic. Covering this story was a titanic work for a single person, and, again, collaboration was key to face this up. Working with a developer, we automated part of the data process (gathering, cleaning, standardising and visualising data) and we've created stories - such as the travel tracker - which updated automatically to offer the latest information to our users without any daily human intervention This is one of the projects which has had a great impact internally. It has contributed to saving dozens of hours, especially to the data team, increasing the number of stories and visualisations published and offering up-to-date information at any time to our users. This system has also impacted on creating consistency among the departments, increasing the efficiency in the data and design departments and improving the content of many of our digital stories. Moreover, it has been recognised externally, as we were invited to talk about it at the Journalism AI Conference and it was shortlisted in the SIGMA Awards. Several experts have also praised many of the data stories, such as the one about the lack of diversity among the UK councilors, the investigation about the deforestation in the Amazon and the shortage of general practitioners (GPs) in England. Likewise, the scroll-down technique to present the data in many of the stories better present the information and increase the engagement, and it has also been highlighted by people in and out of the industry. Pageviews are also a good metric to assess the impact. Many of the data stories have been in the top ten of the most viewed on our digital site. In fact, the story about the shortage of GPs in England has been one of the most-read stories of 2021, even though it was published at the end of the year.
2022-f-0001.summaryJa: 私が紹介するすべてのプロジェクトではデータ分析とデータビジュアライゼーションを担当し,またストーリーを協調して,視聴者向けにより良く表現しました.私はR,Python,Excel,Open Refine,QGIS,Google Sheetsなどの複数のデータツールを使用して,データ収集,クリーン・アンド・分析,および視覚ストーリーを伝えるために Flourish,Datawrapperを使ってビジュアライゼーションを構築しました. 私は日常的な記事や中長期プロジェクトや調査で働きました.つまり,すべての必要性を満たすために,私は時間を効率的に管理しなければならなかったのです.毎日と週間の記事への圧力は,英国やヨーロッパにおける感染や過剰な死亡に関するCOVID分析や,世界中のワクチン導入における不平等やワクチン供給におけるインドの重要性を明らかにするための分析など,かなり高くなりました. 私は高いレベルの分析を行い,短時間で - 時々1日以内に - ストーリーを共同制作し,ビジュアライゼーションを構築しました. その時間圧力を加えて,国際メディアで働くことは,高い期待を満たし,多様なオーディエンスに届くこと,より大きなデータチームと競争することになります. 長いプロジェクトや調査で働いていたら協力の能力が強くなりスカイニュースの多くの部門と強力な仕事関係を築きました気候変動により避難した人々についての物語はデザイナーやジャーナリストや外部組織 (内部移住監視センター) と連携し,最近設立された法医学チームと協力してブラジルアマゾンで最も保護された地域で森林伐採が明らかになった.最初の2年間に最大の課題の一つは,パンデミックに直面していた. この物語をカバーすることは一人一人のために大きな仕事であり,またこの課題に取り組み出すには協力が不可欠でした.開発者と協力して,データ処理の一部を自動化 (データ収集,清掃,標準化,視覚化) しました.そして,トラッキングのようなストーリーを作成しました. これは,日常的な人間の介入なしに,ユーザーに最新の情報を提供するために自動的に更新されます. データを扱うチームにとって特に数十時間の節約,掲載されたストーリーやビジュアライゼーションの数を増やし,いつでもユーザーに最新情報を提供することに貢献しています.このシステムは部門間の一貫性を高め,データやデザイン部門の効率性を高め,多くのデジタルストーリーのコンテンツを向上させています. また,この研究は,ジャーナリズムAI会議で議論するよう招待され,SIGMA賞に選ばれ,多くの専門家が多くのデータストーリーを賞賛した.例えば,英国の議員の多様性の欠如,アマゾンにおける森林伐採に関する調査,イギリスにおける一般医師の不足など. 関連記事の多くを紹介するスクロールダウン技術も,情報をより良く提示し,エンゲージメントを増やすため,業界内外の人々も強調しています.ページビューは,影響を評価するための良い指標でもあります.多くのデータストーリーは,デジタルサイトで最も視聴されたトップ10に収められています. 実際,イギリスにおける GPの不足に関する記事は,年末に発表されたものの, 2021年の最も読まれている記事の一つでした.

2022-f-0004.summary: I have worked as a journalist for 10 years and my work has had a real impact on society. Stories I've written in the past 10 years helped to save millions in public funds and investigate illegal practices from individuals, companies and governments. I was responsible for a story that revealing that a bid result was already set before the due date. It made a city save millions in public funds. Using public data, I found out that high-level officials received housing benefits ilegally from public universities for years. A court said they should give the money back. Using social media data, I was able to investigate and highlight the most impactful disinformation network in Brazil during the 2018 presidential elections. They were reaching more people than famous artists like Anitta or Madonna. The story made Facebook shut their pages down a week later. I have also coordinated a series of articles that led government authorities to investigate and then shut down an illegal air charter service, seize illegal airplanes and sanction people and companies who were operating those services. Most of my stories are based in multiple public records. That's why I also coordinate or contribute to multiple projects that improve government transparency. I co-founded an NGO that finds, organizes and releases relevant public data for free. It is being used as a source of data by all the major news outlets in Brazil, both at local, national and international levels.
2022-f-0004.summaryJa: 私は10年間ジャーナリストとして働き私の仕事は社会に大きな影響を与えました過去10年間書いた物語は公共資金で何百万ドルを節約し個人や企業や政府の違法行為を調査しました発表結果は期限前に決まりました都市が公共資金で何百万ドルを節約しました公的なデータを利用して,私は,高層の関係者が,数年間,公立大学から違法に住宅福利を受け取ったことを知りました.裁判所は,彼らはお金を返さなければならないと言いました.ソーシャルメディアデータを利用して,私は,2018年の大統領選挙でブラジルで最も影響のある誤報ネットワークを調査し,強調することができました.彼らはアニッタやマドンナのような有名なアーティストよりも多くの人に届いていました. この物語はFacebookを一週間後に閉鎖させた. 政府の当局が違法な航空チャーターサービスを調査しその後閉鎖し違法な航空機を捕まえ違法な航空機を運行し違法な航空機を運行する人々や企業を制裁する記事をまとめました私の物語の多くは複数の公共記録に基づいていますだから政府透明性を向上させる複数のプロジェクトを協調したり貢献したりしています関連的な公共データを無料で見つけ,整理し,公開するNGOを共同設立しましたブラジルでは地方,国家,国際的にすべての主要なニュース・アウトレーターがデータソースとして利用しています

2022-f-0006.summary: In the Covid world, the best and worst of each one of us has emerged. In the midst of the health crisis, the same people that refused states intervention demanded a governmental response. In some cases, the polarization of political ideas has led to creating trenches where those sympathizing with the government were convinced that every measure was right and well taken. The opposing side tended to dismiss all actions as wrong, without taking a single minute for analysis. But if things aren't black or white in normal times, one can only imagine how many shades of gray there are in a global crisis no politician was ever prepared to deal with. This series was born after a political decision: to use Argentina's flag carrier, state-owned Aerolíneas Argentinas, to transport the Sputnik V vaccines produced in Russia. Aerolíneas Argentinas is an icon for the political tribal war the country has been into for the last 70 years: Peronism and anti-Peronism. Without any bias -better said, having gotten rid of all of our biases- we tried to explore a couple of simple questions: does this logistical effort make any sense? Are those saying that this is a political deal that is not good for our country right? Can we set the record straight from a technical point of view, in a way that is precise and accurate but easy to read? What you're about to read was created not to end the fight. We wouldn't be able to intervene there. But what we accomplished was, for us, much more important: we elevated the level of discussion. When these articles appeared, people needed to stop repeating information that was incorrect. We exposed big media as they created pieces based on improper data, by mistake, or purposefully. We got cited by Aerolineas' CEO, to defend its operation logic. We got cited by people on the two sides of the trenches. But the most important part was that a good number of people that got stranded on the disinformation were able to discern and think for themselves to reach their own conclusions. Besides all clicks, ads, revenue, relevance, virality, all that matters is that. We created pieces that made people think. What more can we wish as a reward for what we love to do.
2022-f-0006.summaryJa: コビッドの世界では,私たち一人ひとりにとって最も良いことと最悪のことが生まれました.健康危機の真っ只中に,介入を拒否した同一人びとは政府の対応を要求しました. いくつかのケースでは,政治的考えの偏分化により,政府に共感する人々は,あらゆる措置が正しいと正しく受けられていると確信した溝が形成されました.反対側は,分析に1分もかかずに,すべての行動を誤ったものとして否定する傾向がありました. しかし,もし普通の時代では,物事は黒や白ではないなら, グローバル危機にどんなに多くの灰色の色が存在するのか想像できます. 政治家は対処する準備ができていなかった. このシリーズは政治的決定の後生まれました. アルゼンチン旗艦機,アルゼンチン国有航空会社,ロシアで製造されたスプートニクVワクチンを輸送するために. 偏見なく - ベター・ザ・ベター,私たちの偏見をすべて排除した上で - 私たちは簡単な質問をいくつか探求しようとしましたこの物流の努力は意味があるか? 記録を技術的な観点から直し直し精密に正確で読みやすくできるでしょうか? 読むのが簡単です. 読むことが出来上がったのは戦いを終わらせるためにではありません. 介入することはできません. しかし,私たちが達成したのは,私たちにとって,もっと重要なことでした:議論のレベルを高めました. これらの記事は登場したとき,人々は間違った情報を繰り返すのを止めなければなりませんでした. 誤りや意図的に不正なデータに基づいて作品を作っていることを大メディアに暴露しました運用論理を擁護するためにエアラインナスのCEOに引用されました溝の両側の人たちが引用しましたしかし最も重要なのは誤った情報に困った人々の多くは自分たちの結論に達するために判断し自分たちのために考えることができましたクリックや広告収益関連性ウイルス性などにかかわらず私たちは人々を考えさせました好きなことへの報奨としてもっと何が必要なのか

2022-f-0007.summary: I have produced video series on the issues women face in Gilgit Baltistan the area from where CHINA PAKISTAN ECONOMIC CORRIDOR (CPEC) started. The area is still in poverty women work from dawn to dusk along with the men. The first project portrait how women work there as Carpenters. The project described their courage instead of facing many hardships and low wage rates. The second project is based on Hunza's music school where females are learning the art of traditional music side by side with males. These girls are no less than anyone and through learning music, the community is preserving the traditional music. The third project described that how the people of Gulmit constructed the first longest men made stairs in Pakistan. Their motive is to bring tourism to their lands through which they will earn a livelihood for their families. This project made a record of being the first longest stairs of Pakistan. The fourth one is an article under the category of data journalism. The article describes the tabbo of Pakistani society 'marital rape'. Also describes how women are being treated as prisoners and how they have been the victim of marital rape. this article, also discusses what the law of Pakistan says about marital rape.
2022-f-0007.summaryJa: 私は,中国パキスタン経済走廊 (CPEC) が始まった地域であるギルギット・バルティスタンで女性が直面する問題に関するビデオシリーズを制作しました.この地域はまだ貧困状態にあります.女性たちは,男性と一緒に夜明けから夕暮れまで働いています.最初のプロジェクトでは,女性が木工として働くပုံကို描いています.このプロジェクトは多くの困難と低賃金率に直面する代わりに,彼らの勇気を記述しています. 2番目のプロジェクトは,女性たちが男性と並んで伝統音楽の芸術を学ぶフンザの音楽学校に基づいています.これらの少女は誰よりも少なくありません.音楽を学ぶことで,コミュニティは伝統音楽を保存しています. 3番目のプロジェクトは,グルミットの人々は,パキスタンで最初の長い男性を階段を建てた方法を説明しています.彼らの動機は,彼らの土地に観光をもたらし,そのを通じて家族のために生計を立てることでしょう. このプロジェクトは,パキスタン初の最も長い階段として記録を記録しました. 第4回はデータジャーナリズムというカテゴリーの下にある記事です.この記事では,パキスタン社会のタボ"結婚強姦"を記述しています.また,女性が囚人としてどのように扱われているか,そして,結婚強姦の被害を受けたかについても説明しています.この記事では,また,パキスタン法律が結婚強姦について言っていることを議論しています.

2022-f-0008.summary: The stories I am submitting are from data received from Kenya. The data however gives a wider perspective on what is happening in Kenya. Owing to the Covid-19 pandemic, many Kenyans lost their jobs or had to close their businesses because of lockdown. It follows that rent cases shot up. At the same time, married couples breaking the law by marrying other lovers also shot up. This could be explained by the fact that there were those stuck together in their houses and needed ' a breaker'. Bigamy is illegal in Kenya and carries a 5 year prison term. All this is contained in a booklet launched early on the status of the Kenya judiciary.

2022-f-0009.summaryJa: この記事は,Togo (西アフリカ) の固定インターネットセクター,事業者の売上,購読者基盤,投資,そして導入された技術などの部門の重要な人物について, レビューしています. 掲載された後,この記事は,最も重要な意思決定者 (大臣,CEO,機関) によって共有された非常にポジティブなフィードバックを得ました. 公開後2週間でプラットフォームの視聴率が急増しました TwitterやLinkedInでもインタラクションはもっと多かったのですデジタル問題専門の企業がモバイル市場に対して同じ分析を提示しました現在進行中の作業ですこの記事は,前回の記事と同様に,さまざまな俳優に読書格を与えました. この記事は,ここからスクラップされたデータから構築された動力的でインタラクティブなグラフで新しいものを代表するため,今年も2021年の最大の成功の一つであり続けています. 公開されたときショック波でした https://www.togofirst.com/fr/bank/2210-8766-私立国家企業-誰-子供-親愛なる-タゴラ銀行-同じ風脈で,この記事は,ソーシャルメディアで流通する偽ニュースの発生に伴い, トゴのような経済で熱い議論の大きな話題である. トゴの港湾のターミナルの一つは11ヶ月で打ち負かされました. ニュースには,フランスの億万長者がローメで好評を受け,地元の公衆はあまり評価していないため,イタリア・スイスの船長にボローレの活動が売却されたという噂が流れたとき, MSC船長が到着してから観察された動態が明らかになった. ローメ港は,最も優れたコンテナ輸送の100港の関連リストに入りました. 我々はこの情報への独占権を持っていました. ビデオはネットワーク上でホットケーキのように共有されましたビデオは,世界銀行データをスクラップすることで Pythonとハードコーディングを開発したレースバーですウェストアフリカ経済・通貨連合 (Uemoa) の最も重要な銀行グループランキング.この記事は私たちの聴衆を大幅に増加させました.何よりも,それは私たちの読者に経済統合領域で働く力を知ることができます. 新しい読書鍵.

2022-f-0010.summary: This portfolio spans diverse news events, but the stories share a common thread in the way they make use of data, particularly textual analysis. In one analysis, of activity on the conservative social platform Parler, linked the rise in use of the phrase "civil war" on Jan. 6 to the moment in President Trump's speech when he told the crowd to "fight like hell." Pulling in a tranche of Parler posts from the Social Media Analysis Toolkit API, we also found a dramatic negative turn in user sentiment the moment Trump took the stage. The project was cited in President Trump's second impeachment trial. Another analysis of the Capitol attack, published Jan. 12, documented and quantified the spread of claims that Antifa ran a "false flag" operation fomenting the mob, showing a steady migration from extreme fringe users of social media to Fox News and lawmakers giving speeches on the House floor. A few days later, we used ProPublica's congressional Twitter data to identify the partisan breakdown of lawmakers who lost followers when Twitter cracked down on spreaders of QAnon misinformation. Our analysis found the move took away thousands of Twitter users who followed GOP lawmakers. Another story followed deplatformed Twitter users onto new platforms, including the dark web. We tapped the SMAT API to search Parler posts once again, consulted Crowdtangle to examine Facebook activity, and scoured Telegram data provided to us by the Social Computing Group at the University of Zurich. These data sources revealed calls for violence were only growing. For an April news story, we used R to compile contents of more than 5,000 files hacked from the crowdfunding website GiveSendGo, using regular expressions to find connections to the Proud Boys and Jan. 6 rioters. The files, which contained donor names, comments and donation amounts, revealed a trend: people with Chinese surnames contributing to Proud Boys campaigns. Extremism reporter Will Carless and investigative intern Brenna Smith tagged the names while data reporter Aleszu Bajak helped quantify donations. Also in April, we used data to illuminate public perceptions of race and policing. We examined a range of data sources to gauge sentiments following a Minnesota jury's conviction of Derek Chauvin in George Floyd's death. Among the findings: Utilizing a unique panel of Twitter users whom researchers have verified as conservative and liberal based on voter registration data, we documented the right's disproportionate focus on Rep. Maxine Waters' remarks as grounds for a mistrial -- and the left's turn to names of Black men and women killed by police in the days before the verdict. News consumers barely tuned in to the verdict with the exception of two markets: Minnesota and Washington, D.C. The number of mentions of George Floyd from members of Congress dwarfed those of any other Black man killed by police in recent years in the moments following legal decisions in their cases. We again turned to language analysis in November following Election Day. One story focused on how conservative personas drove the rise of "Critical Race Theory" as a battle cry. It drew on a database of TV news transcripts hosted at Stanford University and transcripts of campaign videos, conservative podcasts, think tank publications and radio shows. We mapped the weaponization of the term including the importance of words related to classroom education in Glenn Youngkin's win as Virginia governor. Collectively, these penetrating stories drew 1.2 million pageviews, averaging 160,000 each. They gave readers new tools to understand an overwhelming deluge of bad news. We submit this portfolio as an example of explanatory data journalism at its best.
2022-f-0010.summaryJa: このポートフォリオは様々なニュースイベントをカバーしているが,データ,特にテキスト分析を活用する方法において,物語は共通点を持っています.保守的なソーシャルプラットフォームの活動に関する1つの分析では,"内戦"という表現の使用の増加が1月1日に関連付けられている. ソーシャルメディア分析ツールキット APIからパーラー投稿を抽出すると,トランプがステージに登った瞬間,ユーザー感情の劇的な否定的な転換点も確認されました.このプロジェクトはトランプ大統領の第二弾裁判で引用されました.キャピトルの攻撃の別の分析は1月2日に発表された. 12 件で,アンティファが暴力を煽る"偽旗"作戦を運営していたという主張の拡散を記録し,数値化した.これは,ソーシャルメディアの極端な利用者からフォックス・ニュースへの安定的な移行を示し,議会のフロアで演説する議員を記録した.数日後,我々は,QAnonの誤った情報拡散者に対してTwitterが弾圧したときにフォロワーを失った立法者の党派的な破綻を特定するために,ProPublicaの議会のTwitterデータを利用した. 分析によると,この動きは共和党議員を追った何千人ものツイッターユーザーを取り除いた.別の記事では,ダークウェブを含む新しいプラットフォームにTwitterのデプラフォーマーユーザーを追随した.我々はSMAT APIを再び利用して,パラーラー投稿を検索し,Facebook活動を調べるためにCrowdtangleに相談し,チューリッヒ大学社会コンピューティンググループが提供したテレグラムデータをスキャンした.これらのデータ源は暴力への呼びかけが増加していることを示した. 4月のニュース記事では,Rを使ってクラウドファンディングウェブサイトGiveSendGoからハッキングされた5000以上のファイルの内容をまとめました. Proud Boysと1月6日の暴動者とのつながりを探すための定期的な表現を使用しました.ドナー名,コメント,寄付金を含むファイルは,中国人姓を持つ人々が Proud Boysキャンペーンに貢献する傾向を示しました. 極端主義記者のウィル・カーレスと調査インターン・ブレンナ・スミスが名前をタグ付けしデータ記者のアレセズー・バヤクが寄付を量化するのに役立ちます.また4月に,私たちは人種や警察に関する公共の認識を明るみにするためにデータを利用しました. 私たちはミネソタ州陪審員のジョージ・フロイドの死に対するデレク・チャウインの有罪判決の後,感情を測定するためにさまざまなデータソースを調査しました. 結論としては: 選挙人登録データに基づいて保守的で自由主義であると検証したツイッターユーザーのユニークなパネルを活用し選挙人登録データに基づいて投票者登録データに基づいて投票者登録した投票者に対して投票を妨げる理由として右派が選挙人マクシーン・ウォーターズの発言に格差を絞ったことを記録し判決前の数日で警察に殺害された黒人男性と女性の名前を記録し左派が判決を無視したばかりですニュース消費者は判決にほとんど耳を傾けませんでしたミネソタ州とワシントンD.C. ジョージ・フロイドの言及数は,近年,警察が裁判の決定後,他の黒人男性を殺した事件よりもはるかに多い.選挙日後の11月に再び言語分析に目を向けた.ある記事は,保守派の人たちが"批判的人種理論"の興起を戦いの叫びとしてどのように推進したかに焦点を当てた. スタンフォード大学で放送されたテレビニュース・トランスクリプトやキャンペーンビデオ,保守的なポッドキャスト,シンクタンク出版物,ラジオ番組のトランスクリプトをベースにした. グラレン・ユウマニークがバージニア州知事を務めたときのクラス教育に関連する言葉の重要性を含む用語の武器化を地図化しました. ニュースの大量に影響を与える新しいツールを提供しましたこのポートフォリオは解説データジャーナリズムの優れた例として提供します

2022-f-0011.summary: 2021 was the election year. 1. Measuring Unmeasurable: statistical modeling of opinion poll Probably the first introduction of statistical modeling to opinion poll in Japanese news organization. This article explains what statistical modeling is and its need as the survey environment is getting worse and worse. Manual classification of tweets saying “I got a opinion poll call” shows traditional survey calls from news organizations are overwhelmed by robocalls from non-journalism organizations. Two statistical models shows the support of ruling LDP are over-represented by 2-4 times in comparison with opposition parties, indicating suffocating atmosphere in “free society”. 2. Who follows LDP president candidates on SNS: Self-descriptions of followers in Liberal Democratic Party President race Natural language analysis of the self-description words of the Twitter accounts who followed 4 candidates of LDP leader. 40% of the followers of a rightwing candidate, Sanae Takaichi, used “Japan” or “Japanese” in their profile, showing substantial support of ultra-nationalism in Japan. A 3D chart compares the size of followers/followees and frequency of tweet showing the condensed community of rightwing users. 3. Side by side translation of Biden inaugural address: 4. Imagining the bell shapes from sounds: How goes the gravitational wave observations Visual/audio explanation of the GW observations and the impact of the lag in participation of KAGRA, Japan’s observatory, to the international network of astronomy. A 3D graphics shows how the probabilities of the directions from which GW came were calculated by multiple observations on Earth. 5. Galois field in Auto Factory: Why QR code was invented and how it works Visual explanation of QR code as a quite rare, tangible example of abstract math underlying digital society. Interview of the inventor, Masahiro Hara.
2022-f-0011.summaryJa: 2021年は選挙年でした. 1. Measuring Unmeasurable: statistical modeling of opinion poll おそらく日本語ニュース組織における第1回統計モデリングの導入です. ニュース組織からの伝統的な調査電話は,非ジャーナリズム組織からの robocallsによって圧倒されている. 2つの統計モデルが示す LDPの支持は,反対政党と比較して 2-4 倍に圧倒されている. SNSでLDP大統領候補者をフォローする:LDP大統領候補者の4人をフォローしたTwitterアカウントの自叙語語解析.右翼候補のSanaae Takaichiのフォロワーの40%は,日本<unk><unk>または日本<unk><unk><unk>を自分のプロフィールで使用し,日本におけるultra-nationalismの実質的な支持を示した. A 3D chart is comparing the size of followers/followees and frequency of tweet showing the condensed community of rightwing users. 3. Side by side translation of Biden inaugural address: 4. Imagining the bell shapes from sounds: How goes the gravitational wave observations GW observations Visual/audio explanation and the impact of the lag in participation of KAGRA, Japan<unk>s observatory, to the international network of astronomy. A 3D graphics shows how the probabilities of the directions from which GW came were calculated by multiple observations on Earth. 5. Galois field in Auto Factory: Why QR code was invented and how it works QRコードの視覚説明は,デジタル社会を基盤とする抽象数学のかなり稀な,具体的な例として機能している.

2022-f-0012.summary: The "A-share Green Report" project is a long-term data journalism project that continuously generates new stories and is constantly upgraded. In over one year from September 2020 to December 2021, we reported over 2000 environmental risk events through AI + Writing, and conducted 59 in-depth analysis reports , 5 A-share environmental risk lists and an annual report. Every week, reporters fact-check and clean up the nearly 100 pieces of data which is provided by IPE, and then turn the data into instant news in batches by AI + Writing .The reporter then further cross-compared other types of data from listed companies to analyze and explore the impact of environmental incidents on listed companies, forming an in-depth analysis report "A-Share Green Weekly". This project has pioneered a new model for mining news through dynamic data in China and has also created a unique environmental risk assessment list for listed companies in China. The challenge we face is to check and clean up complex and diverse raw data, and to accurately match the equity relationships of related companies. At present, the reporter has worked out a set of efficient methods with technical assistance. In addition, the standardized evaluation of professional environmental information is also a challenge. But now we have jointly developed a set of persuasive environmental performance scoring mechanisms with our partner institutions IPE. In this project, the most complex part is to cooperate with different departments and different agencies. Such a workflow mechanism needs to be explored gradually in the long-term operation. The impact of the "A-share Green Report" project is very obvious. It promotes more than 50 listed companies to actively fulfill their environmental responsibilities.
